AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda and Cognito authentication

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: API Gateway deployment stage name
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client

Resources:
  McpFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  McpFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${McpFunctionLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  McpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Description: Placeholder handler for the Maths MCP server
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt McpFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "ok"}),
              }
    DependsOn:
      - McpFunctionLogGroup

  Api:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api"
      Description: Maths MCP API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      ParentId: !GetAtt Api.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer"
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  HealthMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      ResourceId: !GetAtt Api.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${McpFunction.Arn}/invocations"
    DependsOn:
      - McpFunctionPermission

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${McpFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: "{\"statusCode\": 200}"
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  McpFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref McpFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api}/*"

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      Description: Maths MCP API deployment
    DependsOn:
      - HealthMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref Api
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-access-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs"

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL of the Maths MCP API
    Value: !Sub "https://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${DeploymentStage}"
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  FunctionName:
    Description: Name of the MCP Lambda function
    Value: !Ref McpFunction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Fargate ECS task definition that references a container image in a private
  ECR repository. The image URI is built dynamically from the current account
  ID, region, repository name and an immutable image tag.

Parameters:
  ContainerRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-app
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 256
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid ECR repository name (lowercase letters, numbers and
      single separators).
    Description: Name of the ECR repository that stores the container image.

  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1.0.0
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid image tag (letters, numbers, underscores, periods and
      dashes; must not start with a period or dash).
    Description: Immutable tag of the container image to reference.

Resources:
  ContainerRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref ContainerRepositoryName
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images after 14 days",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 14
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/sample-app"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: ECS task execution role used to pull the image from ECR and write logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEcsTasksToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ecr-image-pull-and-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowEcrAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: AllowPullFromContainerRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerRepository.Arn
              - Sid: AllowLogStreamWrites
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "${LogGroup.Arn}:*"

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the application code running inside the container.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEcsTasksToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sample-app"
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "512"
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: sample-app
          Image: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ContainerRepository}:${ImageTag}"
          Essential: true
          ReadonlyRootFilesystem: true
          Privileged: false
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 8080
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

Outputs:
  ImageUri:
    Description: Fully qualified ECR image URI referenced by the task definition.
    Value: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ContainerRepository}:${ImageTag}"

  RepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the ECR repository that stores the container image.
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerRepository.RepositoryUri

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Fargate task definition.
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Self-contained Amazon Cognito authentication infrastructure for the
  "nih-grants" application. Includes a user pool with MFA and enforced
  advanced security mode, an identity pool supporting authenticated and
  unauthenticated identities (guest access disabled by default), a web and a
  general-purpose app client with 30-day refresh tokens, and IAM roles
  attached to the identity pool via role mapping.

Parameters:
  AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities:
    Description: >
      Whether unauthenticated (guest) identities are permitted to obtain AWS
      credentials from the identity pool. Disabled by default.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: nih-grants-user-pool
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Your verification code"
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      MfaConfiguration: "ON"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Name: email
          Required: true
        - AttributeDataType: Boolean
          Mutable: true
          Name: email_verified
          Required: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  GeneralAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-general-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: nih-grants-identity-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: !Ref AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities
      AllowClassicFlow: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebAppClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
        - ClientId: !Ref GeneralAppClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-authenticated-role
      Description: IAM role assumed by authenticated identities of the nih-grants identity pool
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowS3ObjectOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*"
              - Sid: AllowKmsDataKeyOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/nih-grants-s3-key"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "kms:RequestAlias": "alias/nih-grants-s3-key"
              - Sid: AllowApiGatewayWebSocketConnect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:Invoke
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/@connections/*"

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-unauthenticated-role
      Description: IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities of the nih-grants identity pool
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-unauthenticated-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadCognitoSyncData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeIdentityPoolUsage
                  - cognito-sync:GetIdentityPoolConfiguration
                  - cognito-sync:ListDatasets
                Resource: "*"

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the nih-grants user pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolProviderName:
    Description: The Cognito user pool provider name
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the nih-grants identity pool
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: The app client ID for the web application
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  GeneralAppClientId:
    Description: The app client ID for general purpose use
    Value: !Ref GeneralAppClient
  AuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the authenticated IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the unauthenticated IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless email submission API (API Gateway -> Amazon SES) with API key, usage plan, request validation and throttling.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Description: API Gateway stage name.
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens or underscores.
  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the API key.
    Default: email-apikey
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-email-api'
      Description: REST API that accepts email submission requests and forwards them to Amazon SES.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Name: EmailRequest
      Description: JSON schema for an email submission request.
      ContentType: application/json
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: EmailRequest
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
          from:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          html:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          text:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
          subject:
            type: string

  EmailRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Name: email-body-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  EmailResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: emails

  ApiGatewaySesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to send email through Amazon SES.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ses-send-email
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'

  EmailPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref EmailResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref EmailRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:email:action/SendEmail'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySesRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.header.Content-Type: '''application/x-www-form-urlencoded'''

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Reusable nested stack that conditionally subscribes email, SQS, Lambda and
  HTTPS endpoints to an existing SNS topic. Each subscription is created only
  when its endpoint parameter is supplied with a value that differs from the
  documented sentinel default.

Parameters:
  TopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:placeholder:topic"
    Description: >-
      Required ARN of the existing SNS topic to subscribe to. The default is a
      sentinel placeholder that disables all subscriptions in this stack.

  EmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: "example@example.com"
    Description: >-
      Optional email address to subscribe. Leave at the sentinel default to
      skip creating the email subscription.

  QueueArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:placeholder:queue"
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing SQS queue to subscribe. Leave at the sentinel
      default to skip creating the SQS subscription.

  LambdaArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:placeholder:function:placeholder"
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing Lambda function to subscribe. Leave at the
      sentinel default to skip creating the Lambda subscription.

  HttpsEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: "https://example.com/placeholder"
    Description: >-
      Optional HTTPS endpoint URL to subscribe. Leave at the sentinel default
      to skip creating the HTTPS subscription.

Conditions:
  TopicProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref TopicArn
      - "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:placeholder:topic"

  EmailProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref EmailAddress
      - "example@example.com"

  QueueProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref QueueArn
      - "arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:placeholder:queue"

  LambdaProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref LambdaArn
      - "arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:placeholder:function:placeholder"

  HttpsProvided: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref HttpsEndpoint
      - "https://example.com/placeholder"

  CreateEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition TopicProvided
    - !Condition EmailProvided

  CreateQueueSubscription: !And
    - !Condition TopicProvided
    - !Condition QueueProvided

  CreateLambdaSubscription: !And
    - !Condition TopicProvided
    - !Condition LambdaProvided

  CreateHttpsSubscription: !And
    - !Condition TopicProvided
    - !Condition HttpsProvided

Resources:
  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref EmailAddress
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn

  QueueSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateQueueSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint: !Ref QueueArn
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn

  LambdaSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: lambda
      Endpoint: !Ref LambdaArn
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn

  HttpsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateHttpsSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: https
      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpoint
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 1
          maxDelayTarget: 60
          numRetries: 10
          numMaxDelayRetries: 0
          numNoDelayRetries: 0
          numMinDelayRetries: 0
          backoffFunction: exponential
        throttlePolicy:
          maxReceivesPerSecond: 1

Outputs:
  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Description: ARN of the created email subscription.
    Value: !Ref EmailSubscription

  QueueSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateQueueSubscription
    Description: ARN of the created SQS subscription.
    Value: !Ref QueueSubscription

  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateLambdaSubscription
    Description: ARN of the created Lambda subscription.
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubscription

  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: CreateHttpsSubscription
    Description: ARN of the created HTTPS subscription.
    Value: !Ref HttpsSubscription

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions calculator demo backed by an inline Node.js Lambda function.

Resources:
  CalculatorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/Calculator
      RetentionInDays: 3

  CalculatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: Calculator-Lambda-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Calculator-Lambda-Logging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CalculatorLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CalculatorLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  Calculator:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: Calculator
      Description: Performs add, subtract, multiply or divide on two operands.
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CalculatorRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref CalculatorLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          'use strict';

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const payload = event || {};
            const operator = payload.operator;
            const operands = payload.operands;

            if (!Array.isArray(operands) || operands.length !== 2) {
              throw new Error('Input must contain exactly two operands');
            }

            const left = Number(operands[0]);
            const right = Number(operands[1]);
            if (Number.isNaN(left) || Number.isNaN(right)) {
              throw new Error('Operands must be numbers');
            }

            let result;
            switch (operator) {
              case 'add':
                result = left + right;
                break;
              case 'subtract':
                result = left - right;
                break;
              case 'multiply':
                result = left * right;
                break;
              case 'divide':
                if (right === 0) {
                  throw new Error('Cannot divide by zero');
                }
                result = left / right;
                break;
              default:
                throw new Error('Unsupported operator: ' + operator);
            }

            return { operator: operator, operands: [left, right], result: result };
          };

  CalculatorStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: Calculator-StateMachine-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Calculator-StateMachine-InvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn

  CalculatorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: Calculator-StateMachine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt CalculatorStateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        StartAt: ChooseOperation
        States:
          ChooseOperation:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: add
                Next: Add
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: subtract
                Next: Subtract
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: multiply
                Next: Multiply
              - Variable: $.operator
                StringEquals: divide
                Next: Divide
            Default: UnknownOperator
          Add:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn
              Payload.$: $
            ResultSelector:
              output.$: $.Payload
            Next: Done
          Subtract:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn
              Payload.$: $
            ResultSelector:
              output.$: $.Payload
            Next: Done
          Multiply:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn
              Payload.$: $
            ResultSelector:
              output.$: $.Payload
            Next: Done
          Divide:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn
              Payload.$: $
            ResultSelector:
              output.$: $.Payload
            Next: Done
          Done:
            Type: Succeed
          UnknownOperator:
            Type: Fail
            Error: UnsupportedOperator
            Cause: The operator must be one of add, subtract, multiply or divide.

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the calculator state machine.
    Value: !Ref CalculatorStateMachine

  CalculatorFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the calculator Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref Calculator

  SampleInput:
    Description: Example input accepted by the calculator state machine.
    Value: '{"operator": "add", "operands": [1,2]}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 bastion-style AMI with EC2 Image Builder.
  The build installs the latest SSM Agent, MongoDB 8.0 database tools and
  mongosh, Python with the Synapse client, and the .NET SDK used by a
  GitHub Actions self-hosted runner. The template is fully self-contained and
  creates its own VPC with a private build subnet, a public subnet hosting a
  NAT Gateway, and the IAM resources Image Builder requires.

Parameters:
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Size of the root EBS volume, in GiB, for the resulting AMI.

  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.0.0"
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version such as 1.0.0.
    Description: Version assigned to the Image Builder image recipe.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^(o-[a-z0-9]{10})?$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Leave empty, or provide an AWS Organizations ID such as o-abcdef1234.
    Description: >-
      Optional AWS Organizations ID with which the resulting AMI is shared.
      When set, the organization ARN is derived using the account that
      deploys this stack, so deploy from the organization's management
      account. When left empty, organization sharing is skipped.

  PublicAmiSharing:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      Set to true to make the resulting AMI public so it is available to all
      AWS accounts. This requires the account setting "Block public access
      for AMIs" to be disabled, otherwise AMI distribution fails. It is
      disabled by default because that account setting is enabled by default
      and cannot be changed from CloudFormation.

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, ""]]
  IsPublicAmiSharingEnabled: !Equals [!Ref PublicAmiSharing, "true"]
  HasLaunchPermissions: !Or
    - !Condition HasOrganizationId
    - !Condition IsPublicAmiSharingEnabled

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-igw"

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-public"

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-private"

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-nat"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Security group for EC2 Image Builder build instances. No inbound
        traffic is permitted; outbound traffic uses the VPC default egress
        so the build can reach package repositories and AWS APIs through the
        NAT Gateway.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-sg"

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Instance role used by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-build-instance-role"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  InstallSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-install-software"
      Description: Installs SSM Agent, MongoDB tools, Python Synapse client and .NET SDK.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Data: |
        name: bastion-install-software
        description: Install prerequisite software for the bastion server image.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: installLatestSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y amazon-ssm-agent
                    - dnf upgrade -y amazon-ssm-agent
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: installMongoDbTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - printf '%s\n' '[mongodb-org-8.0]' 'name=MongoDB Repository' 'baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/' 'gpgcheck=1' 'enabled=1' 'gpgkey=https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-8.0.asc' > /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo
                    - dnf install -y mongodb-database-tools mongodb-mongosh
              - name: installPythonAndSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - python3 -m venv /opt/synapse
                    - /opt/synapse/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
                    - /opt/synapse/bin/pip install synapseclient
              - name: installDotNetSdk
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0

  BastionImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-recipe"
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 bastion-style server image recipe.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3

  BastionDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-distribution"
      Description: Shares the bastion AMI with the configured organization and optionally with all AWS accounts.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: Amazon Linux 2023 bastion-style server image.
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion"
              ManagedBy: EC2 Image Builder

    Properties:
      Name: WS-API
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for WS-API

  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Channel {
          name: String!
          data: AWSJSON!
        }

        type Query {
          getChannel(name: String!): Channel
        }

        type Mutation {
          publish2channel(name: String!, data: AWSJSON!): Channel
        }

        type Subscription {
          subscribe2channel(name: String!): Channel
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["publish2channel"])
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  DataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:

    Properties:

      FieldName: publish2channel
      DataSourceName: pubsub
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |

  RepoUrl:
    Type: String

Resources:
  SageMakerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NotebookInstanceName}-sagemaker-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  RAPIDSLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: !Sub "${NotebookInstanceName}-lifecycle-config"
      OnCreate:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e
              CONDA_DIR=/home/ec2-user/anaconda3

              if [ ! -d "$CONDA_DIR/envs/rapids" ]; then
                # Create minimal environment (fast), register kernel
                $CONDA_DIR/bin/conda create -y -n rapids -c conda-forge python=3.11 pip
                $CONDA_DIR/envs/rapids/bin/pip install -q ipykernel

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained SLO monitoring stack for the FSx for ONTAP event-driven
  pipeline pattern. Creates four CloudWatch SLO alarms (EventIngestionLatency,
  ProcessingSuccessRate, FPolicyReconnectTime and ReplayCompletionTime) and a
  CloudWatch dashboard with annotated time-series widgets, synthetic canary
  widgets and an alarm status widget. All resources are created only when
  EnableSloMonitoring is "true".

Parameters:
  EnableSloMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      Deploy the SLO alarms and dashboard when set to "true". Nothing is
      created when set to "false" (default).

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 60
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only
      alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Prefix applied to the names of all created resources.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9._/#:-]+$"
    Description: CloudWatch namespace that holds the pipeline SLO metrics.

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9._/#:-]+$"
    Description: CloudWatch namespace that holds the synthetic canary metrics.

  AwsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]+$"
    Description: >-
      Region used by the dashboard widgets when querying metrics. Defaults to
      us-east-1.

  AlarmSnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing SNS topic that receives alarm state change
      notifications. Leave empty to deploy the alarms without notification
      actions.

  EventIngestionLatencyP99ThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0
    Description: >-
      P99 event ingestion latency (seconds) at which the EventIngestionLatency
      SLO is considered breached.

  ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: >-
      Average processing success rate (percent) below which the
      ProcessingSuccessRate SLO is considered breached.

  FPolicyReconnectTimeMaxThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    Description: >-
      Maximum FPolicy reconnect time (seconds) at which the FPolicyReconnectTime
      SLO is considered breached.

  ReplayCompletionTimeMaxThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    Description: >-
      Maximum replay completion time (seconds) at which the ReplayCompletionTime
      SLO is considered breached. The default of 300 seconds is 5 minutes.

Conditions:
  CreateSloResources: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableSloMonitoring
    - "true"

  HasAlarmSnsTopic: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
      - ""

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSloResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency-P99"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        P99 event ingestion latency exceeded the SLO threshold over three
        consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyP99ThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Seconds
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasAlarmSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSloResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate-Avg"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average processing success rate dropped below the SLO threshold over
        three consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Percent
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasAlarmSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSloResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime-Max"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Maximum FPolicy reconnect time exceeded the SLO threshold over three
        consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeMaxThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Seconds
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasAlarmSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSloResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime-Max"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Maximum replay completion time exceeded the SLO threshold over three
        consecutive 5-minute periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeMaxThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Seconds
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasAlarmSnsTopic
        - - !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  SloDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: CreateSloResources
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard"
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                  "region": "${AwsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency", { "stat": "p99", "label": "P99 ingestion latency" } ]
                  ],
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      { "label": "SLO threshold ${EventIngestionLatencyP99ThresholdSeconds} s", "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyP99ThresholdSeconds} }
                    ]
                  },
                  "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds" } }
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                  "region": "${AwsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate", { "stat": "Average", "label": "Average success rate" } ]
                  ],
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      { "label": "SLO threshold ${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent} %", "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent} }
                    ]
                  },
                  "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "max": 100, "label": "Percent" } }
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 6,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time (Maximum)",
                  "region": "${AwsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime", { "stat": "Maximum", "label": "Maximum reconnect time" } ]
                  ],
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      { "label": "SLO threshold ${FPolicyReconnectTimeMaxThresholdSeconds} s", "value": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeMaxThresholdSeconds} }
                    ]
                  },
                  "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds" } }
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 6,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Replay Completion Time (Maximum)",
                  "region": "${AwsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime", { "stat": "Maximum", "label": "Maximum replay completion time" } ]
                  ],
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      { "label": "SLO threshold ${ReplayCompletionTimeMaxThresholdSeconds} s", "value": ${ReplayCompletionTimeMaxThresholdSeconds} }
                    ]
                  },
                  "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Seconds" } }
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 12,
                "width": 8,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Canary - S3 Access Point List Latency",
                  "region": "${AwsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APListLatency", { "stat": "Average", "label": "List latency" } ]
                  ],
                  "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Milliseconds" } }
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 8,
                "y": 12,
                "width": 8,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Canary - S3 Access Point Get Latency",
                  "region": "${AwsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APGetLatency", { "stat": "Average", "label": "Get latency" } ]
                  ],
                  "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "label": "Milliseconds" } }
                }
              },
              {

Outputs:

  and MCP server. Supports self-service signup with email verification, hosted

  grant.

Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-

      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'

        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:

          - Name: verified_email

      Name: "Pet Store API"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "domestic.read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read access to domestic pet store data"

  # M2M OAuth2 App Client
  MyAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - MyResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref MyUserPool
      ClientName: !Ref WebClientName

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi

      Name: "PetStoreAPI"

      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # Resource path: /pets
  MyApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MyApi

  # Cognito User Pool Authorizer
  MyAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MyApi
      Name: "CognitoAuthorizer"
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS

            - ":"

        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST

  # Deployment (must wait for all methods to be configured)
  MyDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment

    Properties:

  # Log group for API Gateway access logs
  MyApiLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:

        - - "aws-api-gateway-"
          - !Ref MyApi
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:

  MyApiLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"

          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:

                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # Global API Gateway account configuration associating the logging role
  MyApiAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    DependsOn:
      - MyApiLogRole
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt MyApiLogRole.Arn

  # Production stage with INFO logging and full data tracing
  MyStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - MyApiLogRole
      - MyApiAccount
      - MyApiLogGroup
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MyApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref MyDeployment
      StageName: "prod"
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        Format: "$context.requestId $context.httpMethod $context.path $context.status $context.protocol"
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt MyApiLogGroup.Arn
      MethodSettings:

          DataTraceEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

        - !Sub "${AWS::Region}"

        - !Ref MyUserPool

            - Fn::Split:
                - "/"
                - !Sub "${AWS::StackId}"
        - ".auth."
        - !Sub "${AWS::Region}"
        - ".amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AWS Backup infrastructure with daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules using tag-based selection"

Parameters: {}

Resources:
  # KMS Key for vault encryption with rotation enabled
  BackupKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS encryption key for AWS Backup vaults
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # IAM Service Role for AWS Backup
  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: aws-backup-service-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: aws-backup-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - backup:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetTagKeys
                  - tag:GetTagValues
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ListGrants
                  - kms:RevokeGrant
                Resource: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # Daily Backup Vault
  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: daily-backup-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
        Schedule: daily

  # Weekly Backup Vault
  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: weekly-backup-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
        Schedule: weekly

  # Monthly Backup Vault
  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: monthly-backup-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
        Schedule: monthly

  # Daily Backup Plan
  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: daily-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: daily-rule
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: UTC
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14
      BackupPlanTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
        Schedule: daily

  # Daily Backup Selection
  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: daily-backup-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionKey: aws:ResourceTag/backup
            ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionValue: daily

  # Weekly Backup Plan
  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: weekly-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: weekly-rule
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: UTC
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56
      BackupPlanTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
        Schedule: weekly

  # Weekly Backup Selection
  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: weekly-backup-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionKey: aws:ResourceTag/backup
            ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionValue: weekly

  # Monthly Backup Plan
  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: monthly-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: monthly-rule
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 1 * ? *)
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: UTC
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365
      BackupPlanTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
        Schedule: monthly

  # Monthly Backup Selection
  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: monthly-backup-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionKey: aws:ResourceTag/backup
            ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionValue: monthly

  # Service Catalog TagOptions for backup tag values
  DailyBackupTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily
      Active: true

  WeeklyBackupTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly
      Active: true

  MonthlyBackupTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly
      Active: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Public hosted zone and the full set of DNS records for a self-contained
  external services domain (defaults to podcastgarage.org): Squarespace web
  hosting, G Suite mail and DMARC reporting, Google Workspace DKIM, ZenDesk
  helpdesk verification, Campaign Monitor email marketing, and an internal
  office printer address.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    Description: Apex domain for the public hosted zone (no leading or trailing dots).
  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: 8jbW4R2vXqZ9dLmK3pQeN6tYcFuHsA
    Description: Token used in the Google site ownership verification TXT record.
  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: zndk-vrf-7G3hJ9kL2xP5qR8
    Description: Token for the ZenDesk domain ownership verification TXT record.
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQDgmNVS2Gmd2v8g8PfW1t5B0OqkTcHrGPhdYz8Qafj+3nF4cVQpJcR7V9gZqFzD8v0c4xHmNmXyY2xvYpO1IhGtE
    Description: Base64 RSA public key for the Google Workspace DKIM TXT record.
  CampaignMonitorDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQCs80bRzB2EwYhJq9xQmFx7Hj4WnKplT3uDgZvNM9aSrP0cBfYkWt5N2sCX6HuR1POoQjK7zV8aGmdT
    Description: Base64 RSA public key for the Campaign Monitor DKIM TXT record.
  CampaignMonitorSendingSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: mail
    Description: Dedicated SPF-aligned subdomain used by Campaign Monitor for sending.
  PrinterIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.168.1.200
    Description: Internal IPv4 address of the office printer.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName}'

  RootSquarespaceA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145

  WwwSquarespaceCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-cust.squarespace.com

  RootTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - !Sub '"zendesk-verification=${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

  RootGoogleMailMx:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com'

  DmarcTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@${DomainName}"'

  PrinterA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'printer.${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIP

  GoogleWorkspaceDkimTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${GoogleWorkspaceDkimKey}"'

  ZendeskValidationCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk-validation.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - validation.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDkimCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - dkim1.zendesk.com

  CampaignMonitorDkimTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm1._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${CampaignMonitorDkimKey}"'

  CampaignMonitorSpfTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSendingSubdomain}.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:spf.createsend.com ~all"'

  CampaignMonitorMx:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSendingSubdomain}.${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - '10 bounce.m1.createsend.com'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM roles and managed policies for an e-commerce serverless architecture:
  a Lambda role that consumes messages from POC-Queue-{env} and writes orders to
  the ecommerce-orders-{env} DynamoDB table, a Lambda role that reads DynamoDB
  Streams on the same table and publishes to POC-Topic-{env}, and an API Gateway
  role that sends messages to POC-Queue-{env}. All resources include the
  necessary scoped managed policies plus a basic Lambda CloudWatch Logs
  execution policy, and the role ARNs are exported for cross-stack references.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: >-
      Environment name used to scope the names of the SQS queue, DynamoDB table,
      and SNS topic referenced by the IAM policies and to suffix exported values.

Resources:
  LambdaBasicExecutionManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-lambda-basic-execution-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Basic Lambda execution policy granting write access to CloudWatch Logs for Lambda functions in the ${Environment} environment.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*'

  PocQueueConsumerManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-poc-queue-consumer-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Grants a Lambda function permission to consume messages from the POC-Queue-${Environment} SQS queue.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ConsumePocQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'

  OrdersTableWriterManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-orders-table-writer-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Grants a Lambda function permission to write order items to the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} DynamoDB table.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: WriteOrdersTable
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}'

  OrdersTableStreamReaderManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-orders-table-stream-reader-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Grants a Lambda function permission to read DynamoDB Streams on the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} table.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOrdersTableStream
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*'

  PocTopicPublisherManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-poc-topic-publisher-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Grants a Lambda function permission to publish messages to the POC-Topic-${Environment} SNS topic.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PublishToPocTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}'

  PocQueueProducerManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-poc-queue-producer-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Grants API Gateway permission to send messages to the POC-Queue-${Environment} SQS queue.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SendToPocQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'

  EcommerceLambdaOrdersProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Environment}-lambda-orders-processor-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Role for the Lambda function that consumes POC-Queue-${Environment} and writes order items to the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} DynamoDB table.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServicePrincipal
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionManagedPolicy
        - !Ref PocQueueConsumerManagedPolicy
        - !Ref OrdersTableWriterManagedPolicy

  EcommerceLambdaStreamPublisherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Environment}-lambda-stream-publisher-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Role for the Lambda function that reads DynamoDB Streams on the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} table and publishes messages to the POC-Topic-${Environment} SNS topic.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServicePrincipal
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionManagedPolicy
        - !Ref OrdersTableStreamReaderManagedPolicy
        - !Ref PocTopicPublisherManagedPolicy

  ApiGatewaySqsProducerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Environment}-apigateway-sqs-producer-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Role for API Gateway to send messages to the POC-Queue-${Environment} SQS queue.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowApiGatewayServicePrincipal
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref PocQueueProducerManagedPolicy
