final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  PII Classification Scanner – scans files in an S3 bucket via Amazon Comprehend
  DetectPiiEntities, stores classification reports in DynamoDB with optional SNS
  notifications. When the access point is VPC-origin, deploy the Lambda inside
  that VPC and optionally create the required VPC endpoints.

Metadata:
  ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      VPC ID for Lambda deployment when the access point is VPC-origin.
      Leave empty for internet-origin (outside VPC).
    Default: ""
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated subnet IDs for Lambda VPC deployment. Required when
      VpcId is supplied.
    Default: ""
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Security group ID for Lambda VPC deployment and VPC Interface endpoints.
      Required when VpcId is supplied.
    Default: ""
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated route table IDs for Gateway VPC endpoints. Required when
      VpcId is supplied.
    Default: ""
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Whether to create VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, and SNS.
      Set to false if the target VPC already has these endpoints.
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  MemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Description: Lambda function memory in MB.
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: Lambda function timeout in seconds.
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Description: Default language code for Comprehend DetectPiiEntities.
    Default: "en"
    AllowedValues:
      - "en"
      - "es"
      - "fr"
      - "de"
      - "it"
      - "pt"
      - "zh"
      - "ja"
      - "ko"
      - "ar"
  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per Lambda invocation.
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Email address to subscribe to SNS notifications. Leave empty for no
      subscription.
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  IsVpcScoped:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref VpcId
          - ""
  IsNotVpcScoped:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref VpcId
      - ""
  ShouldCreateEndpoints:
    Fn::And:
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - !Ref VpcId
              - ""
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref CreateEndpoints
          - "true"
  HasNotificationEmail:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref NotificationEmail
          - ""

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 bucket holding files to be scanned (the "Access Point")
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for S3 bucket and SNS topic encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Description: Customer-managed key for S3 bucket and SNS topic encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"

  EncryptionAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/pii-scanner-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  ScannerBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table for classification reports (PITR + encryption)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ClassificationTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: FileName
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: FileName
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for the scanner Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScannerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:s3:::${ScannerBucket}"
                  - Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:s3:::${ScannerBucket}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ClassificationTable}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource:
                  Fn::If:
                    - HasNotificationEmail
                    - Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${NotificationTopic}"
                    - "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS topic and subscription (conditional on notification email)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NotificationTopic:
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  NotificationSubscription:
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scanner Lambda – VPC-scoped variant
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScannerFunctionVpc:
    Condition: IsVpcScoped
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: ""
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CLASSIFICATION_TABLE: !Ref ClassificationTable
          SCANNER_BUCKET: !Ref ScannerBucket
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
            Fn::If:
              - HasNotificationEmail
              - !Ref NotificationTopic
              - ""
          COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
      VpcConfig:
        SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref SecurityGroupId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scanner Lambda – no-VPC variant
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScannerFunctionNoVpc:

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: ""
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CLASSIFICATION_TABLE: !Ref ClassificationTable
          SCANNER_BUCKET: !Ref ScannerBucket
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
            Fn::If:
              - HasNotificationEmail
              - !Ref NotificationTopic
              - ""
          COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints (conditional – only when creating endpoints)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:

      SecurityGroupIds:

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:

    Properties:

      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates two AWS Glue databases, one for property graph (LPG) tables and one
  for RDF tables, and provisions comma-separated Glue tables for the Neptune
  Spark connectors. The LPG database 'graph-database' contains the airport,
  country, continent, route and customairport tables (Gremlin vertex/edge/view
  labels plus a Gremlin traversal selecting source and destination airport
  codes for up to 10 routes). The RDF database 'graph-database-rdf' contains
  airport_rdf (querymode class, classuri class:Airport), route_rdf and
  route_rdf_nopfx (querymode sparql) tables, all rdf-type with URI prefix
  stripping enabled and sample URIs from the air-routes ontology.

Resources:
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: graph-database
        Description: >-
          Property graph (LPG) database holding the airport, country,
          continent, route and customairport tables for the Neptune Gremlin
          Spark connector.
        Parameters:
          purpose: property-graph-lpg

  GraphDatabaseRdf:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: graph-database-rdf
        Description: >-
          RDF database holding the airport_rdf, route_rdf and route_rdf_nopfx
          tables for the Neptune SPARQL Spark connector.
        Parameters:
          purpose: rdf

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: >-
          Airport vertices for the property graph. Graph label type is
          'vertex'. Comma-separated fields.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: gremlin
          labelType: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/airport
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: altitude
              Type: int
            - Name: continent
              Type: string
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Description: >-
          Country vertices for the property graph. Graph label type is
          'vertex'. Comma-separated fields.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: gremlin
          labelType: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/country
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: continent
              Type: string
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Description: >-
          Continent vertices for the property graph. Graph label type is
          'vertex'. Comma-separated fields.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: gremlin
          labelType: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/continent
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Description: >-
          Route edges for the property graph. Graph label type is 'edge'.
          Comma-separated fields. The Gremlin traversal selects source and
          destination airport codes for up to 10 routes.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: gremlin
          labelType: edge
          gremlinQuery: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').as('src').out('route').as('dst').select('src','dst').by('code').limit(10)"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/route
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: src
              Type: string
            - Name: dest
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        Description: >-
          Custom airport view for the property graph. Graph label type is
          'view'. Comma-separated fields.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: gremlin
          labelType: view
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/customairport
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: altitude
              Type: int
            - Name: continent
              Type: string
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Description: >-
          RDF table for the Airport class, same columns as the LPG airport
          table. Query mode is 'class' with classuri 'class:Airport'. Marked
          rdf-type with URI prefix stripping enabled. The 'class' prefix maps
          to the air-routes ontology class namespace.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: sparql
          querymode: class
          classuri: "class:Airport"
          rdf-type: "true"
          strip-uri-prefix: "true"
          prefix_class: "http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#"
          prefix_datatypeproperty: "http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#"
          prefix_objectproperty: "http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#"
          prefix_rdf: "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
          prefix_rdfs: "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
          prefix_xsd: "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/airport_rdf
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: altitude
              Type: int
            - Name: continent
              Type: string
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Description: >-
          RDF table for routes with query mode 'sparql'. The SPARQL query
          references the air-routes ontology URIs via separate prefix
          parameters. Marked rdf-type with URI prefix stripping enabled.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: sparql
          querymode: sparql
          rdf-type: "true"
          strip-uri-prefix: "true"
          prefix_ar: "http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#"
          prefix_rdf: "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
          prefix_rdfs: "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
          prefix_xsd: "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
          sparqlQuery: |-
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE {
              ?route ar:route ?dest .
              ?route ar:incode ?incode .
              ?route ar:outcode ?outcode .
              ?route ar:dist ?dist .
            } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/route_rdf
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  RouteRdfNopfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Description: >-
          RDF table for routes with query mode 'sparql'. The SPARQL query
          embeds the full air-routes ontology URIs directly in the query text
          instead of using prefix parameters. Marked rdf-type with URI prefix
          stripping enabled.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          queryType: sparql
          querymode: sparql
          rdf-type: "true"
          strip-uri-prefix: "true"
          sparqlQuery: |-
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE {
              ?route <http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#route> ?dest .
              ?route <http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#incode> ?incode .
              ?route <http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#outcode> ?outcode .
              ?route <http://air-routes.org/ontologies/air-routes#dist> ?dist .
            } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://graph-database-data/route_rdf_nopfx
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
              serialization.format: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          Compressed: false
          BucketColumns: []
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

Outputs:
  GraphDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the property graph (LPG) Glue database
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabase
  RdfGraphDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the RDF Glue database
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito Authentication Setups - Web App and IoT Trusted User Provisioning

Parameters:
  WebAppUserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: pibot-web-app-user-pool
    Description: Name for the web app user pool
  WebAppIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: pibot-web-app-identity-pool

Resources:
  # ============================================================

  WebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref WebAppUserPoolName
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: email
          Required: true
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: phone_number
          Required: false
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: preferred_username
          Required: false
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

  WebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Route 53 hosted zone and comprehensive DNS configuration for the
  radiotopia.fm production domain, including apex records,
  CloudFront-backed subdomain alias record pairs, ACM certificate
  validation CNAME records, and verification/DKIM records for third-party
  mail and marketing services.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web Application Firewall (WAFv2) for CloudFront distributions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WAFAcl:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: RadiotopiaWAF
      Name: radiotopia-waf

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route 53 Hosted Zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RadioTopiaZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront Distributions (one per subdomain)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaCDN:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for media.radiotopia.fm
        HttpVersion: http2
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WAFAcl.Arn

  TowerCDN:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for tower.radiotopia.fm
        HttpVersion: http2
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WAFAcl.Arn

  V1CDN:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Origins:
          - Id: DefaultOrigin
            DomainName: radiotopia.fm
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: DefaultOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET

            - OPTIONS
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD

          ForwardedValues:

          DefaultTTL: 86400

          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for v1.radiotopia.fm
        HttpVersion: http2
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WAFAcl.Arn

            - GET

            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 86400
          MaxTTL: 31536000
          Compress: true
        Enabled: true
        IPV6Enabled: true
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for plus.radiotopia.fm
        HttpVersion: http2
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WAFAcl.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Apex TXT – SPF policy plus two domain ownership verification tokens
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexSPF:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref RadioTopiaZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - >-
          "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:servers.mcsv.net
          include:spf.zendesk.com include:sendgrid.net ~all"
          "google-site-verification=8B9C87F7D9A8B0A4C1E2"
          "squarespace-verification=6E2D8F4A1B9C7D3E5F0A"
        - '"squarespace-verification=3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b"'
        - '"google-site-verification=7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMARC TXT record – reject policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexDMARC:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref RadioTopiaZone
      Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=reject; adkim=s; aspf=s; rua=mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm; ruf=mailto:dmarc-forensics@radiotopia.fm; rf=afrf; pct=100; fo=1"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MX record – Google Workspace hosted email
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexMX:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref RadioTopiaZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: MX

        - 5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
        - 10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
        - 10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref RadioTopiaZone
      Name: www.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - proxy-ssl.squarespace.com.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subdomain CNAME records – CloudFront distributions

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref RadioTopiaZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !GetAtt MediaCDN.DomainName

  TowerCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref RadioTopiaZone
      Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !GetAtt TowerCDN.DomainName

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration
  supporting an AI agent for protein variant effect prediction.
  Dynamically resolves configuration from SSM Parameter Store.
  (iac-god-eval)

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: >-
      Project name used as a prefix for resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: >-
      Gateway for MCP-based protein variant effect prediction agent powered by
      Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
    Description: Description for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional explicit name for the gateway. If left blank an auto-generated
      name based on the ProjectName is used.

Conditions:
  UseAutoGatewayName:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - ''

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito UserPool – minimal JWT token issuer for the Gateway authorizer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      UserPoolTags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.UserPoolId
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-client'
      GenerateSecret: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameters – configuration store consumed by downstream resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/lambda-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt PlaceholderLambda.Arn
      Description: >-
        ARN of the Lambda function serving as the MCP target. Managed by the
        AgentCore Gateway infrastructure.
      Tier: Standard
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub
        - 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPoolId}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
        - UserPoolId: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.UserPoolId
      Description: >-
        OpenID Connect Discovery URL for the Cognito JWT authorizer.
      Tier: Standard
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPoolClient.ClientId
      Description: >-
        OAuth 2.0 client identifier registered with the Cognito user pool.
      Tier: Standard
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Description: >-
        ARN of the IAM role created for the bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
        service principal.
      Tier: Standard
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Minimal Lambda function – MCP target placeholder
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PlaceholderLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-basic-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  PlaceholderLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-bridge'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.13
      Role: !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'OK'}
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-lambda-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaArnParameter.Value
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::If:
          - UseAutoGatewayName
          - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
          - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !GetAtt CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter.Value
          AllowedAudience:
            - !GetAtt CognitoClientIdParameter.Value
          AllowedClients:
            - !GetAtt CognitoClientIdParameter.Value
          AllowedScopes:
            - openid
            - profile
            - email
      ProtocolType: MCP
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SupportedVersions:
            - '2025-03-26'
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Target – MCP Lambda Target with inline tool schema
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayArn: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-target'
      Description: >-
        MCP target connecting the gateway to the protein variant prediction
        Lambda function
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt LambdaArnParameter.Value
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: >-
                    Submit protein sequences for variant effect prediction.
                    Provide one or more amino-acid sequences and the variant
                    positions to evaluate.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      sequences:
                        Type: array
                        Items:
                          Type: string
                        Description: List of protein amino-acid sequences
                      variants:
                        Type: array
                        Items:
                          Type: object
                          Properties:
                            position:
                              Type: integer
                            wild_type:
                              Type: string
                            mutant:
                              Type: string
                          Required:
                            - position
                            - wild_type
                            - mutant
                        Description: List of variant definitions
                    Required:
                      - sequences
                      - variants
                  OutputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                      status:
                        Type: string
                    Required:
                      - job_id
                      - status
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: >-
                    Retrieve the results of a previously submitted variant
                    effect prediction job using the job identifier returned by
                    invoke_endpoint.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                    Required:
                      - job_id
                  OutputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                      status:
                        Type: string
                      predictions:
                        Type: array
                        Items:
                          Type: object
                          Properties:
                            position:
                              Type: integer
                            wild_type:
                              Type: string
                            mutant:
                              Type: string
                            score:
                              Type: number
                            confidence:
                              Type: number
                          Required:
                            - position
                            - wild_type
                            - mutant
                            - score
                      error:
                        Type: string
                    Required:
                      - job_id
                      - status

          "Comment": "Simple two-step pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "Step1",
          "States": {
            "Step1": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Next": "Step2"
            },
            "Step2": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn

  # ========== API 1: GET endpoint ==========

  # IAM role allowing API Gateway to start state machine executions (GET API)
  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: GetApiStepFunctionsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineFromGetApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref MyStateMachine

  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: GetApi
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts the state machine

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri:
          Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:states/action:StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json:
            Fn::Sub: |
              {"input": "$util.escapeJsString($input.json('$'))", "stateMachineArn": "${MyStateMachine}"}
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: "200"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"message":"State machine execution started","executionId":"$input.path('$.executionArn')"}

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      StageName: !Ref GetApiStageName

  # ========== API 2: POST endpoint ==========

  # IAM role allowing API Gateway to start state machine executions (POST API)
  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PostApiStepFunctionsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineFromPostApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref MyStateMachine

  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: PostApi
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts the state machine

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri:
          Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:states/action:StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json:
            Fn::Sub: |
              {"input": "$util.escapeJsString($input.json('$'))", "stateMachineArn": "${MyStateMachine}"}
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: "200"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"message":"State machine execution started","executionId":"$input.path('$.executionArn')"}

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      StageName: !Ref PostApiStageName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights foundation layer: least-privilege Lambda execution roles
  for the scraper, analysis, alerts, API, admin and archival microservices, the
  Bedrock AgentCore runtime role, and the placeholder Secrets Manager secrets
  under the hospitality-insights/<Environment>/ naming prefix.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and the Project tag.
    Default: hospitality-insights
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, must start with a letter
      and end with a letter or digit.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment name (used in names and as a key prefix).
    Default: prod
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, must start with a letter
      and end with a letter or digit.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project name
      Environment:
        default: Environment

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Secrets Manager: naming-prefix anchor secret and ScrapingBee API key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  PrefixSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    # Establishes the hospitality-insights/<Environment> naming prefix used by
    # every other secret and by the IAM resource patterns below.
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}/${Environment}/config"
      Description: !Sub >-
        Naming-prefix anchor secret for the Hospitality Insights
        (${ProjectName}) ${Environment} environment.
      SecretString: !Sub |
        {
          "project": "${ProjectName}",
          "environment": "${Environment}",
          "secretPrefix": "${ProjectName}/${Environment}/"
        }
      KmsKeyId: !Ref SecretsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    # Placeholder: no API key is stored in the template. Populate it after
    # deployment (secretsmanager:PutSecretValue) with the real key.
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}/${Environment}/scrapingbee/api-key"
      Description: >-
        Placeholder for the ScrapingBee API key used by the scraper Lambda.
      SecretString: '{"apiKey":"REPLACE_ME"}'
      KmsKeyId: !Ref SecretsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SecretsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer managed key for ${ProjectName} ${Environment} secrets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowAwsServicesViaGrantsOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:ViaService":
                  - !Sub "secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"

  SecretsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/secrets"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SecretsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-lambda-role"
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the Hospitality Insights scraper Lambda: read/write
        scraped job postings and enqueue raw payloads for analysis.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: scraper-runtime-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: EmployeeScopedLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper:*"
              - Sid: JobPostingTables
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scrape-targets"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scrape-targets/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-job-postings"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-job-postings/index/*"
              - Sid: PublishRawPayloads
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scrape-queue"
              - Sid: ArchiveRawPayloads
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-raw-scrape-data/*"
              - Sid: PrefixSecretLookup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Ref PrefixSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Microservice
          Value: scraper

  AnalysisLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-lambda-role"
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the Hospitality Insights analysis Lambda: consume
        scraped payloads, enrich with Comprehend/Bedrock, orchestrate Step
        Functions and persist insights.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: analysis-runtime-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: EmployeeScopedLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis:*"
              - Sid: ReadAndWriteInsights
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-job-postings"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-job-postings/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-insights"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-insights/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-skills"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-skills/index/*"
              - Sid: ConsumeScrapeQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scrape-queue"
              - Sid: EnqueueInsights
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alert-queue"
              - Sid: ComprehendEnrichment
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:DetectSyntax
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectEntities
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSyntax
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:guardrail/*"
              - Sid: StartAnalysisWorkflows
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-pipeline"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-pipeline:*"
              - Sid: DataLakeReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-raw-scrape-data"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-raw-scrape-data/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-processed-insights/*"
              - Sid: ProjectSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Microservice
          Value: analysis

  AlertsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-lambda-role"
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the Hospitality Insights alerts Lambda: consume
        insight events, read subscriber configuration and publish
        notifications.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: alerts-runtime-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: EmployeeScopedLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts:*"
              - Sid: ConsumeAlertQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alert-queue"
              - Sid: PublishNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-digest"
              - Sid: AlertPreferencesAndHistory
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alert-subscriptions"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alert-subscriptions/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alert-history"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alert-history/index/*"
              - Sid: ReadInsightsForAlerting
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-insights"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-insights/index/*"
              - Sid: ProjectSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Microservice
          Value: alerts

  ApiLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-lambda-role"
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the Hospitality Insights read API Lambda: query
        insights, aggregates and subscriptions without write access to the
        ingestion tables.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Audit SQS queue with KMS encryption, DLQ, CloudWatch monitoring, and SNS alerts"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Description: Deployment environment
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Conditions:
  IsDev:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref Environment
      - "dev"
  IsStaging:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref Environment
      - "staging"
  IsProduction:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref Environment
      - "prod"
  EnableDLQ:
    Fn::Or:
      - !Condition IsStaging
      - !Condition IsProduction

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for SQS audit queue and SNS topic encryption"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      RotationPeriodInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${Environment}-audit-events-dlq"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${Environment}-audit-events"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod:
        Fn::If:
          - IsDev
          - 86400
          - Fn::If:
              - IsStaging
              - 259200
              - 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout:
        Fn::If:
          - IsDev
          - 30
          - Fn::If:
              - IsStaging
              - 60
              - 120
      RedrivePolicy:
        Fn::If:
          - EnableDLQ
          - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt [DeadLetterQueue, Arn]
            maxReceiveCount: 5
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${Environment}-audit-alerts"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  OldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${Environment}-audit-old-messages"
      AlarmDescription: "Alert when messages in the audit queue exceed age threshold"
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !GetAtt [SNSTopic, TopicArn]
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-audit-events"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold:
        Fn::If:
          - IsDev
          - 600
          - Fn::If:
              - IsStaging
              - 1800
              - 3600
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  DLQMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableDLQ
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${Environment}-audit-dlq-activity"
      AlarmDescription: "Alert when messages are sent to the dead letter queue"
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - !GetAtt [SNSTopic, TopicArn]
