AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Cognito User Pool infrastructure for researchapp and AgentCore"

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine OAuth client
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web application OAuth client

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # IAM ROLE for Cognito SMS delivery
  # ============================================================
  SmsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sns-sms-publish
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: "*"

  # ============================================================
  # COGNITO USER POOL
  # ============================================================
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
        - phone_number
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OPTIONAL"
      EnabledMfas:
        - SMS_MFA
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      SmsConfiguration:
        SnsCallerArn: !GetAtt SmsRole.Arn
        ExternalId: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        SnsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Your verification code for researchapp"
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Please use this code {####} to verify your email address for researchapp."
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false

  # ============================================================
  # COGNITO DOMAIN
  # ============================================================
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::Region}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ============================================================
  # COGNITO RESOURCE SERVER with a read scope
  # ============================================================
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore
      Name: agentcore
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to protected resources

  # ============================================================
  # WEB APP CLIENT (Authorization Code Flow)
  # ============================================================
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - agentcore/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      GenerateSecret: false
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback

  # ============================================================
  # MACHINE-TO-MACHINE CLIENT (Client Credentials Flow)
  # ============================================================
  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      GenerateSecret: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

  # ============================================================
  # USER GROUPS
  # ============================================================
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: "Administrator group with elevated privileges"
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: "Customer group with standard access"
      Precedence: 5
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ============================================================
  # LAMBDA FUNCTION: Add new users to customer group
  # (NOT wired as an active Cognito trigger)
  # ============================================================
  AddToCustomerGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-add-to-customer-group-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-group-management
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminRemoveUserFromGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                  - cognito-idp:ListGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-add-to-customer-group"
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """
              Adds a user to the customer group.
              Expects event with: {'username': 'user@example.com'}
              """
              username = event.get('username', event.get('Username', event.get('userName', '')))
              user_pool_id = os.environ.get('USER_POOL_ID')
              group_name = os.environ.get('CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME', 'customer')

              if not username:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Username is required'})
                  }

              try:
                  cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName=group_name
                  )

                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'User {0} added to group {1}'.format(username, group_name),
                          'username': username,
                          'group': group_name
                      })
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'error': str(e),
                          'username': username,
                          'group': group_name
                      })
                  }

  # ============================================================
  # SSM PARAMETER STORE
  # ============================================================
  SSMClientIdWeb:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client-id-web
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient
      Description: Cognito Web App Client ID

  SSMClientIdMachine:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client-id-machine
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client ID

  SSMClientSecretMachine:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client-secret-machine
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client Secret

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  SSMOAuthScopes:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth-scopes
      Type: String
      Value: agentcore/read
      Description: Custom OAuth scopes

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Description: OIDC Discovery URL

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::Region}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
      Description: OAuth Token URL

  SSMAuthorizeUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::Region}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
      Description: OAuth Authorize URL

  SSMCognitoDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito-domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::Region}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: Cognito Domain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CryptoTickerAPI: A self-contained GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data using AWS AppSync backed by DynamoDB'

Parameters:
  AppSyncApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: CryptoTickerAPI
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: APIDataTable
  ApiKeyDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # IAM Role for AppSync to access DynamoDB
  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  # AppSync GraphQL API
  CryptoTickerApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AppSyncApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: false

  # API Key
  CryptoTickerApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Description: !Ref ApiKeyDescription

  # GraphQL Schema
  CryptoTickerSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
          priceHistory(nextToken: String, limit: Int): TickerConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
        }

        type TickerConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord!]!
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  # HTTP Data Source (CoinGecko)
  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  # DynamoDB Data Source
  APIDataDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Name: APIDataDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # Function 1: Fetch current price from CoinGecko
  FetchPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Name: FetchPriceFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price?ids=${ctx.args.symbol}&vs_currencies=usd",
          "params": {
            "headers": {
              "Content-Type": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        ## Parse CoinGecko response
        #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
        #set($price = $body.get($ctx.args.symbol).usd)
        #set($ts = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        ## Stash data for the next function in the pipeline
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("ticker", $ctx.args.symbol))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("priceUsd", $price))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("timestamp", $ts))
        ## Return ticker info as function result
        {
          "ticker": "$ctx.args.symbol",
          "priceUsd": $price,
          "timestamp": "$ts"
        }

  # Function 2: Store price record in DynamoDB
  StorePriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Name: StorePriceFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.ticker),
            "priceUsd": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.priceUsd),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "ticker": "$ctx.stash.ticker",
          "priceUsd": $ctx.stash.priceUsd,
          "timestamp": "$ctx.stash.timestamp"
        }

  # Function 3: Query price history from DynamoDB
  QueryPriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      Name: QueryPriceHistoryFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.ticker)
            }
          },
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken),
          "scanIndexForward": false
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {## Build items list
          "items": [#foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
            {
              "ticker": "$item.ticker",
              "priceUsd": $item.priceUsd,
              "timestamp": "$item.timestamp"
            }#if($foreach.hasNext),#end
          #end],
          "nextToken": #if($ctx.result.nextToken)"$ctx.result.nextToken"#else null#end
        }

  # Pipeline Resolver for Query.ticker
  TickerQueryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StorePriceFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  # Pipeline Resolver for TickerInfo.priceHistory
  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApi.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt QueryPriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

    Description: Default API Key
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApiKey.ApiKey
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB Table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Elemental MediaPackage live channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints,
  optional live-to-VOD archiving and MediaPackage VOD workflows.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9a-zA-Z-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores.'
    Description: Logical name prefix used for naming all resources.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: >-
      Packaging output type. APPLE_HLS creates the HLS endpoint, ISO_DASH the
      DASH endpoint and ALL both endpoints.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[^./][^/]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must not contain slashes and must not start with a dot.'
    Description: Name of the output manifest.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds used by the HLS origin endpoint.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: Time-shifted (start-over) playback window in seconds for HLS and DASH.

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Leave empty to disable archiving, otherwise supply a valid S3 bucket name
      (the bucket must already exist in this account and region).
    Description: >-
      S3 bucket used by MediaPackage for live-to-VOD archiving. When supplied,
      origin endpoint origination is set to DENY so only the MediaPackage VOD
      harvest job can read the live content.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Leave empty to disable VOD workflows, otherwise supply a valid S3 bucket
      name (the bucket must already exist in this account and region).
    Description: >-
      S3 bucket holding source content for MediaPackage VOD assets. Providing
      it (together with ArchiveBucket) provisions the VOD packaging group,
      packaging configurations and asset.

  VodSourceManifestKey:
    Type: String
    Default: index.m3u8
    AllowedPattern: '^[^/].*\.(m3u8|smil)$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be an object key ending in .m3u8 or .smil.'
    Description: >-
      Object key of the source manifest inside VodSourceBucket used when
      creating the VOD asset.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for tagging.

  CustomTags:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional additional custom tags as a comma separated list of up to ten
      key=value pairs, for example "team=media,costcenter=123". Applied to
      every taggable resource. Leave empty to use only the default tags.

Conditions:
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasCustomTags0: !Not [!Equals [!Select [0, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags1: !Not [!Equals [!Select [1, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags2: !Not [!Equals [!Select [2, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags3: !Not [!Equals [!Select [3, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags4: !Not [!Equals [!Select [4, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags5: !Not [!Equals [!Select [5, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags6: !Not [!Equals [!Select [6, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags7: !Not [!Equals [!Select [7, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags8: !Not [!Equals [!Select [8, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  HasCustomTags9: !Not [!Equals [!Select [9, !Split [",", !Sub "${CustomTags},,,,,,,,,"]], '']]
  CreateArchiveRole: !And
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Or
      - !Condition CreateHlsEndpoint
      - !Condition CreateDashEndpoint
  CreateVodWorkflows: !And
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket

Description: IAM roles, instance profiles, and policies for Cluster API Provider AWS

  CAPAControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: CAPA-ControlPlane
      Description: Custom managed policy for CAPA control plane role - EC2, ELB, auto scaling, KMS
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  CAPAControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: CAPA-Controllers
      Description: Custom managed policy for CAPA controllers role - VPC, subnets, SGs, ELB, ASG, launch templates, EKS access entries, service-linked roles
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2FullManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute

              - ec2:CreateTags

              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingFull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AutoScalingFull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntries
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - "autoscaling.amazonaws.com"
                  - "elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com"
                  - "ec2.amazonaws.com"

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSClusterManagement

            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:CreateNodegroup

              - eks:ListNodegroups

              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: SSMParameterRetrieval
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: IAMRolePolicyInspection
            Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:ListRoles

              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy
              - iam:PassRole

          - Sid: KMSKeyOperationsWithAliasCondition
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:ListKeyPolicies
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "DynamoDB table with configurable partition/sort keys, billing mode, SSE encryption, and CloudWatch alarms — iac-god-eval"

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyAppTable
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Attribute name for the partition key (primary HASH key)

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Attribute type for the partition key (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary)

  SortKeyEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable an optional sort (RANGE) key

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: sk
    Description: Attribute name for the sort key (used only when SortKeyEnabled=true)

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Attribute type for the sort key (used only when SortKeyEnabled=true)

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]
    Description: Table billing mode — PROVISIONED (fixed capacity) or PAY_PER_REQUEST (on-demand)

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units (only relevant for PROVISIONED billing)

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units (only relevant for PROVISIONED billing)

  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery (PITR) for the table

  EncryptionEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable server-side encryption (SSE) on the table

  KmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      KMS key ID for customer-managed encryption.
      Required only when EncryptionEnabled=true.
      Leave empty to use the default DynamoDB KMS key.

  AlarmsEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttled requests and system errors

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Email address for SNS alarm notifications.
      Optional; used only when AlarmsEnabled=true.

Conditions:
  UseSortKey:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: SortKeyEnabled
      - 'true'

  IsProvisioned:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: BillingMode
      - PROVISIONED

  EncryptionEnabledCond:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: EncryptionEnabled
      - 'true'

  HasKmsKey:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: KmsKeyId
          - ''

  AlarmsEnabledCond:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: AlarmsEnabled
      - 'true'

  PitrEnabledCond:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
      - 'true'

  HasAlarmEmail:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: AlarmEmail
          - ''

  UseEmailAlarm:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: AlarmsEnabledCond
      - Condition: HasAlarmEmail

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName:
        Ref: TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        Fn::If:
          - UseSortKey
          - - AttributeName:
                Ref: PartitionKeyName
              AttributeType:
                Ref: PartitionKeyType
            - AttributeName:
                Ref: SortKeyName
              AttributeType:
                Ref: SortKeyType
          - - AttributeName:
                Ref: PartitionKeyName
              AttributeType:
                Ref: PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema:
        Fn::If:
          - UseSortKey
          - - AttributeName:
                Ref: PartitionKeyName
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName:
                Ref: SortKeyName
              KeyType: RANGE
          - - AttributeName:
                Ref: PartitionKeyName
              KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode:
        Ref: BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        Fn::If:
          - IsProvisioned
          - ReadCapacityUnits:
              Ref: ReadCapacityUnits
            WriteCapacityUnits:
              Ref: WriteCapacityUnits
          - Ref: AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
          Fn::If:
            - PitrEnabledCond
            - true
            - false
      SSESpecification:
        Fn::If:
          - EncryptionEnabledCond
          - SSEEnabled: true
            SSEType: KMS
            KMSMasterKeyId:
              Fn::If:
                - HasKmsKey
                - Ref: KmsKeyId
                - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          - Ref: AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  SnsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: AlarmsEnabledCond
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  AlarmSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: AlarmsEnabledCond
    Properties:
      TopicName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '-'
          - - Ref: TableName
            - alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId:
        Ref: SnsKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  AlarmSNSSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: UseEmailAlarm
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: AlarmSNSTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint:
        Ref: AlarmEmail

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabledCond
    Properties:
      AlarmName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '-'
          - - Ref: TableName
            - ThrottledRequests
      AlarmDescription:
        Fn::Join:
          - ' '
          - - Alarm when
            - Ref: TableName
            - throttled requests occur
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - Ref: AlarmSNSTopic
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value:
            Ref: TableName

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabledCond
    Properties:
      AlarmName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '-'
          - - Ref: TableName
            - SystemErrors
      AlarmDescription:
        Fn::Join:
          - ' '
          - - Alarm when
            - Ref: TableName
            - system errors occur
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmActions:
        - Ref: AlarmSNSTopic
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value:
            Ref: TableName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86 & arm64) with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, SSM sudo, and public distribution with organizational sharing"

Parameters:
  AmiVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.0.0"
    Description: "Semantic version for the image recipe and component"

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: "Root EBS volume size in GB"
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "AWS Organization ID to share AMIs with (e.g. o-abc123def). Leave empty to skip organizational sharing."

  ParentAmiX86:
    Type: String
    Default: "ami-041607313c6a2a618"
    Description: "Parent AMI ID for x86_64 architecture (Amazon Linux 2023)"

  ParentAmiArm64:
    Type: String
    Default: "ami-00257dfd4933e8013"
    Description: "Parent AMI ID for arm64 architecture (Amazon Linux 2023)"

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, ""]]

Resources:
  # IAM Role and Instance Profile for Image Builder build instances
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "image-builder-profile-${AWS::StackName}"

  # Image Builder component for software installation and test
  InstallSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "install-software-${AWS::StackName}"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref AmiVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - "Amazon Linux 2023"
      Data: |
        name: InstallSoftware
        description: "Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages (synapseclient, pandas, pysftp) and enables SSM user sudo. Validates Docker Compose and Python imports."
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallSoftwareAndConfigure
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -eux
                      dnf install -y docker
                      dnf install -y docker-compose-plugin
                      systemctl enable docker
                      dnf install -y python3-pip
                      pip3 install --upgrade synapseclient pandas pysftp
                      printf "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n" > /etc/sudoers.d/100-ssm-user
                      chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/100-ssm-user
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateInstallation
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -eux
                      docker compose version
                      python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('All Python imports successful')"

  # Image recipe for x86_64
  RecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "al2023-x86-docker-${AWS::StackName}"
      Version: !Ref AmiVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentAmiX86
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp

  # Image recipe for arm64
  RecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "al2023-arm64-docker-${AWS::StackName}"
      Version: !Ref AmiVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentAmiArm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp

  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  InfraConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "al2023-shared-infra-${AWS::StackName}"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m5.large
        - m6g.large
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Sub "imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}"
          S3KeyPrefix: "/build-logs"

  # S3 bucket for Image Builder logs
  ImageBuilderLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # Single distribution configuration shared by both pipelines
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "al2023-dist-${AWS::StackName}"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "al2023-docker-{{ imagebuilder:TargetArchitecture }}-{{ imagebuilder:ImageVersion }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: !Sub "Amazon Linux 2023 with Docker and Python packages, built by ${AWS::StackName}"
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
              ManagedBy: iac-god-eval
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns: !If
                - HasOrganizationId
                - - !Sub "arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # Pipeline for x86_64
  PipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "al2023-docker-x86-${AWS::StackName}"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref RecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

  # Pipeline for arm64
  PipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "al2023-docker-arm64-${AWS::StackName}"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref RecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: iac-god-eval

Description: "Cognito User Pool for AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo"

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:

              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"
        - PolicyName: lambda-logs

                  - logs:PutLogEvents

          import boto3
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          DEMO_PASSWORD = 'Demo1234!'

          USERS = [

              {'email': 'bob@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'member'},
              {'email': 'charlie@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'team_admin'},
              {'email': 'dave@demo.local', 'group': 'team-beta', 'role': 'member'},
              {'email': 'eve@demo.local', 'group': 'team-beta', 'role': 'team_admin'},
              {'email': 'admin@demo.local', 'group': 'admin', 'role': 'admin'},
          ]

          def send_response(event, context, status, data):
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': data.get('Reason', ''),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': data.get('PhysicalResourceId', ''),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data.get('Data', {}),
              }).encode()
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=response_body,
                  headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  method='PUT',
              )
              try:
                  urllib.request.urlopen(req)
              except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                  print(f'Failed to send response: {e.reason}')

          def create_users(user_pool_id):
              for user in USERS:
                  cognito.admin_create_user(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user['email'],
                      TemporaryPassword=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {'Name': 'email', 'Value': user['email']},
                          {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                          {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': user['role']},
                      ],
                      MessageAction='SUPPRESS',

                  cognito.admin_set_user_password(

                      Username=user['email'],
                      Password=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                      Permanent=True,

                  cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user['email'],
                      GroupName=user['group'],

          def delete_users(user_pool_id):

                      cognito.admin_delete_user(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=user['email'],
                      )
                  except cognito.exceptions.ClientError:
                      pass

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      delete_users(user_pool_id)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {
                          'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'user-seeder'),
                      })
                  else:
                      if event['RequestType'] == 'Update':
                          delete_users(user_pool_id)
                      create_users(user_pool_id)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {
                          'PhysicalResourceId': 'user-seeder',
                      })
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Error in handler: {e}')
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {
                      'Reason': str(e),
                      'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId', ''),

    Type: Custom::UserSeeder

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudWatch dashboard and Logs Insights queries for AWS Client VPN usage
  reporting, covering AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth authentication
  methods.

Parameters:
  LogsQueryFolder:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Folder path used to organise the Logs Insights query names.
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for Client VPN logs.

Resources:
  TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${LogsQueryFolder}-Total-Usage-Per-Endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /(?i)(authenticate|connect)/
        | parse @message /"endpoint"[=:[ ]*"?([^",]+)/ as endpoint
        | stats count(*) as connections by endpoint
        | sort connections desc

  UsagePerAuthenticationTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${LogsQueryFolder}-Usage-Per-Authentication-Type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /(?i)(authenticate|connect)/
        | parse @message /"authentication_method"[=:[ ]*"?([^",]+)/ as auth_method
        | stats count(*) as connections by auth_method
        | sort connections desc

  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${LogsQueryFolder}-Distinct-Users'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /(?i)(authenticate|connect)/
        | parse @message /"username"[=:[ ]*"?([^",]+)/ as user
        | stats count(*) as connections by user
        | sort connections desc

  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${LogsQueryFolder}-Connection-Durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /(?i)disconnect/
        | parse @message /"connection_duration"[=:[ ]*"?([0-9.]+)/ as duration
        | stats avg(duration) as avg_duration, max(duration) as max_duration, min(duration) as min_duration

  ADSAMLAuthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${LogsQueryFolder}-AD-SAML-Auth'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /(?i)(saml|active directory)/
        | stats count(*) as ad_saml_connections by @timestamp

  MutualAuthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${LogsQueryFolder}-Mutual-Auth'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message

  MixedAuthQuery:

                { "type": "logs", "x": 0, "y": 6, "width": 12, "height": 6,

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AnyCompany Hotel Cognito User Pool - Guest and Staff Authentication (Plus Tier)"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment for the AnyCompany Hotel platform

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool (Plus Tier with Advanced Security)
  # ------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # SPA Client (Public - SRP auth, no secret)
  # ------------------------------------------------
  SPAUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      GenerateSecret: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # Admin Auth Client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, with secret)
  # ------------------------------------------------
  AdminUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      GenerateSecret: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # M2M OAuth2 Resource Server
  # ------------------------------------------------
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub "https://api.anycompanyhotel-${Environment}.com"
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel API resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel API resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Admin access to AnyCompany Hotel API resources

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # M2M OAuth2 Client (client_credentials flow, with secret)
  # ------------------------------------------------
  M2MUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceServer, "/read"]]
        - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceServer, "/write"]]
        - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceServer, "/admin"]]
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # User Pool Domain
  # ------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool Groups (Staff Roles)
  # ------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Full administrative access to the AnyCompany Hotel platform

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Manager level access at AnyCompany Hotel properties

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Regional manager access across multiple properties

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Revenue management access for pricing and analytics

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Front desk staff access for guest check-in/check-out

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Housekeeping staff access for room management

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

  UserPoolArn:

    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: The domain name prefix of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainName"

  UserPoolDomainURL:
    Description: The full domain URL for the Cognito hosted UI and OAuth2 endpoints

    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainURL"

  SPAUserPoolClientId:
    Description: The Client ID for the public SPA client (SRP auth)

    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SPAClientId"

  AdminUserPoolClientId:
    Description: The Client ID for the admin client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH)
    Value: !Ref AdminUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminClientId"

  AdminUserPoolClientSecret:
    Description: The Client Secret for the admin client

    Export:

  M2MUserPoolClientId:
    Description: The Client ID for the M2M OAuth2 client (client_credentials)

  ResourceServerIdentifier:

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Cognito user pool for Hospitality Insights application - prod environment with SSO support, post-auth Lambda trigger, and user groups"

Parameters:
  LoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "SAML metadata URL for the SSO identity provider (leave empty to disable SSO)"
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of the SAML identity provider in Cognito (leave empty to disable SSO)"
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Custom domain prefix for the Cognito hosted UI (leave empty to skip custom domain)"

Conditions:
  HasDomainPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, ""]]
  HasSSO: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LoginURL, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, ""]]

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: hospitality-insights-prod-post-auth-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-update-last-login
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"

  PostAuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: hospitality-insights-prod-post-auth
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 30
      Description: "Post-authentication Lambda trigger that updates custom:last_login attribute"
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']

              now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {
                          'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                          'Value': now
                      }
                  ]
              )

              return event

  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: hours
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - HasSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOProviderName
        - - COGNITO

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Condition: HasDomainPrefix
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  IdentityProvider:
    Condition: HasSSO
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
      ProviderDetails:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state

Parameters:
  TtlMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    Description: Time-to-live in minutes for session entries in DynamoDB

Resources:
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  WebSocketHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManagementAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/@connections/*

  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, time
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              rc = event.get('requestContext', {})
              route_key = rc.get('routeKey')
              connection_id = rc.get('connectionId')
              domain = rc.get('domainName')
              stage = rc.get('stage')
              ttl_seconds = int(os.environ.get('TTL_MINUTES', '60')) * 60
              ttl = int(time.time()) + ttl_seconds

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  table.put_item(Item={
                      'connectionId': connection_id,
                      'connectedAt': int(time.time()),
                      'ttl': ttl
                  })
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}

              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}

              elif route_key == '$default':
                  ep = f'https://{domain}/{stage}'
                  client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=ep)
                  body = event.get('body', '{}')
                  try:
                      data = json.loads(body)
                  except Exception:
                      data = {'message': body}
                  msg = {'connectionId': connection_id, 'echo': data}
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=connection_id,
                      Data=json.dumps(msg).encode('utf-8')
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Echoed'}

              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Unknown route'}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionsTable
          TTL_MINUTES: !Ref TtlMinutes
      Architectures:
        - arm64

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: SessionWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: api
      AutoDeploy: true

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*

    Description: WebSocket API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/api
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB sessions table name
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable

        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root account full access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key

              - kms:ReEncrypt*

              - kms:CreateGrant

  FISLogsKMSKeyAlias:

  # CloudWatch Log Group for FIS experiment logs

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

                  - ec2:EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                  - ec2:AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable

      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow administration of the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow flow logs role to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${FlowLogsRole}'

        - Key: Name

  FlowLogsRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

              - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
              - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'

            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/emr-on-eks-flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: vpc-flow-logs

  VPCFlowLog:

    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: emr-on-eks-vpc-flow-log
