final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Superwerker-style automated Security Hub deployment across an AWS Organization managed by Control Tower'

Parameters:
  AuditAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID of the audit account (designated Security Hub delegated administrator)
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    Default: '000000000000'
  LogArchiveAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID of the log archive account (onboarded as a Security Hub member)
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    Default: '000000000000'

Resources:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter Store – configuration values consumed by automation
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/audit_account_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AuditAccountId
      Description: AWS account ID of the Security Hub delegated administrator

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/log_archive_account_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref LogArchiveAccountId
      Description: AWS account ID of the log archive Security Hub member

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by SSM Automation executions
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SecurityHubAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: Superwerker-SecurityHubAutomationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SecurityHubManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:UpdateOrganizationConfiguration
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:DisableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:GetEnabledStandards
                  - securityhub:BatchEnableStandards
                  - securityhub:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: OrganizationsManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CrossAccountAssumeRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Sid: ReadSSMParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToSSM
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/Superwerker-SecurityHubAutomationRole'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSSMAutomationRole'

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation Document – initial Security Hub setup (landing-zone ready)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SetupSecurityHubDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: Superwerker-EnableSecurityHubSetup
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >
          Enable Security Hub in the management account, designate the audit
          account as the delegated administrator, configure Organization-wide
          auto-enable, and onboard the log archive account as a member.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: Role ARN used by the automation to execute steps
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReadAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Read the audit account ID from Parameter Store
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/audit_account_id
            outputs:
              - Name: AccountId
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
                Type: String

          - name: ReadLogArchiveAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Read the log archive account ID from Parameter Store
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/log_archive_account_id
            outputs:
              - Name: AccountId
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
                Type: String

          - name: EnableSecurityHubInManagementAccount
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Enable Security Hub in the current (management) account
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: EnableSecurityHub
              EnableDefaultStandards: false
              Tags:
                - Key: ManagedBy
                  Value: superwerker

          - name: EnableOrganizationsServiceAccess
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Allow Security Hub to use AWS Organizations
            inputs:
              Service: organizations
              Api: EnableAWSServiceAccess
              ServicePrincipal: securityhub.amazonaws.com

          - name: RegisterDelegatedAdmin
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Designate the audit account as the Security Hub delegated administrator
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
              MemberAccountId: '{{ ReadAuditAccountId.AccountId }}'

          - name: EnableSecurityHubInAuditAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Assume the AWSControlTowerExecution role in the audit account and enable Security Hub
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: enable_security_hub
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: '{{ ReadAuditAccountId.AccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def enable_security_hub(event, context):
                    account_id = event['AccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='EnableSecurityHub')['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass  # already enabled
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

          - name: ConfigureOrganizationAutoEnable
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: >
              As the delegated admin, configure new accounts to have Security Hub
              enabled automatically. This step runs in the audit account by
              assuming the AWSControlTowerExecution role first.
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: UpdateOrganizationConfiguration
              AutoEnable: true
            # This call must be made from the delegated admin account (audit).
            # We use the same assume‑role approach via executeScript.
            #
            # Note: aws:executeAwsApi always runs in the automation's own account
            # (management).  For the delegated admin call we need the audit
            # account, so we use executeScript.
            timeoutSeconds: 120
            # Actual cross‑account call performed below.

          - name: UpdateOrgConfigFromAuditAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >
              Assume AWSControlTowerExecution in the audit account and set
              Security Hub Organization configuration to auto‑enable new accounts.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: update_org_config
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: '{{ ReadAuditAccountId.AccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def update_org_config(event, context):
                    account_id = event['AccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='UpdateOrgConfig')['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    sh.update_organization_configuration(AutoEnable=True)
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

          - name: OnboardLogArchiveAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >
              Assume AWSControlTowerExecution in the log archive account,
              enable Security Hub, then from the audit account add it as a
              member and send an invitation.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: onboard_log_archive
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ ReadAuditAccountId.AccountId }}'
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{ ReadLogArchiveAccountId.AccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def onboard_log_archive(event, context):
                    audit_id = event['AuditAccountId']
                    log_id = event['LogArchiveAccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')

                    # --- Enable Security Hub in the log archive account ---
                    log_role = f'arn:aws:iam::{log_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    log_creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=log_role, RoleSessionName='EnableLogArchive')['Credentials']
                    log_sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=log_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=log_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=log_creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    try:
                        log_sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                    except log_sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass

                    # --- Assume audit account (delegated admin) and add member ---
                    audit_role = f'arn:aws:iam::{audit_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    audit_creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=audit_role, RoleSessionName='AddLogArchiveMember')['Credentials']
                    audit_sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=audit_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=audit_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=audit_creds['SessionToken'],
                    )

                    # Retrieve account email from Organizations (the audit account
                    # has Organizations read access via the role).
                    org = boto3.client(
                        'organizations',
                        aws_access_key_id=audit_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=audit_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=audit_creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    try:
                        account_info = org.describe_account(AccountId=log_id)
                        email = account_info['Account']['Email']
                    except Exception:
                        email = f'{log_id}@example.com'

                    # Create member and send invitation
                    try:
                        audit_sh.create_members(
                            AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_id, 'Email': email}]
                        )
                    except audit_sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass

                    try:
                        audit_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[log_id])
                    except audit_sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass

                    return {'Success': True, 'LogArchiveAccountId': log_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation Document – onboard a newly created Control Tower account
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  NewAccountSecurityHubDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: Superwerker-EnableSecurityHubNewAccount
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >
          Enable Security Hub in a newly provisioned Control Tower account,
          then from the delegated admin (audit) account add it as a member
          and send an invitation that the new account automatically accepts.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          NewAccountId:
            type: String
            description: AWS account ID of the newly created account
          NewAccountEmail:
            type: String
            description: Email address of the newly created account
            default: ''
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: Role ARN used by the automation
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReadAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Read the audit account ID from Parameter Store
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/audit_account_id
            outputs:
              - Name: AccountId
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
                Type: String

          - name: EnableSecurityHubInNewAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Assume AWSControlTowerExecution in the new account and enable Security Hub
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: enable_security_hub
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: '{{ NewAccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def enable_security_hub(event, context):
                    account_id = event['AccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    # Retry a few times in case the role is not yet fully propagated
                    max_retries = 10
                    for attempt in range(max_retries):
                        try:
                            creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='EnableNewAccountSH')['Credentials']
                            break
                        except Exception as ex:
                            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                                raise
                            time.sleep(15)
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

          - name: AddNewAccountAsMember
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >
              From the audit account (delegated admin), add the new account as a
              member and send an invitation. Wait briefly for the new account to
              be visible to Organizations before proceeding.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: add_member_and_invite
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ ReadAuditAccountId.AccountId }}'
                NewAccountId: '{{ NewAccountId }}'
                NewAccountEmail: '{{ NewAccountEmail }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def add_member_and_invite(event, context):
                    audit_id = event['AuditAccountId']
                    new_id = event['NewAccountId']
                    email = event.get('NewAccountEmail', '') or f'{new_id}@example.com'
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{audit_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='AddNewMember')['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    try:
                        sh.create_members(
                            AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': new_id, 'Email': email}]
                        )
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    try:
                        sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[new_id])
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    return {'Success': True, 'NewAccountId': new_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

          - name: AcceptInvitationInNewAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >
              Assume the AWSControlTowerExecution role in the new account and
              accept the Security Hub invitation from the delegated admin.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: accept_invitation
              InputPayload:
                NewAccountId: '{{ NewAccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def accept_invitation(event, context):
                    account_id = event['NewAccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                    creds = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='AcceptInvite')['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                    )
                    # Wait a moment for the invitation to arrive, then accept it
                    max_retries = 12
                    for attempt in range(max_retries):
                        try:
                            invs = sh.list_invitations()
                            if invs.get('Invitations'):
                                inv_id = invs['Invitations'][0]['InvitationId']
                                sh.accept_invitation(
                                    MasterId=invs['Invitations'][0]['AccountId'],
                                    InvitationId=inv_id,
                                )
                                return {'Success': True, 'InvitationAccepted': inv_id}
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                        time.sleep(10)
                    # If no invitation found yet, that is acceptable – auto‑enable
                    # may handle membership without an explicit invitation.
                    return {'Success': True, 'InvitationAccepted': None}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for multiple EKS deployments.
  Deploys GuardDuty, IAM roles, CloudFormation registry type activations,
  and associated log groups.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment alias used as a prefix for all role names.
  Hash:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional hash appended to role names for disambiguation.
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: example-bastion-bucket
    Description: S3 bucket name used to scope the bastion role's GetObject access.
  # PermissionsBoundaryArn:
  #   Type: String
  #   Default: ""
  #   Description: Optional ARN of a permissions boundary policy. Uncomment in
  #                environments that require it.

Conditions:
  HasHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Hash, ""]]

Rules:
  ValidateEnvAlias:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentAlias, ""]]
        AssertDescription: EnvironmentAlias must not be empty.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GuardDuty
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Groups for CloudFormation Registry Type Activations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  K8sResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 7
      LogGroupClass: STANDARD

  K8sHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 7
      LogGroupClass: STANDARD

  EKSClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 7
      LogGroupClass: STANDARD

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # 1. Lambda execution role — read-only access for resource discovery
  LambdaReadOnlyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-lambda-readonly-discovery
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-readonly-discovery
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  # 2. Lambda role — caller identity, CloudFormation, CloudTrail logs
  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-lambda-caller-identity
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-caller-identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity-cfn-cloudtrail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetStackPolicy
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # 3. Role for describing EKS node groups
  EKSNodeGroupDescriberRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-eks-nodegroup-describer
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-eks-nodegroup-describer
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-nodegroup-describe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                Resource: "*"

  # 4. CloudFormation execution role — broad permissions, max session 8400s
  CFNExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-cfn-execution
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-execution
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-execution-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: eks:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:PutBucketAcl
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - ec2.amazonaws.com
                      - eks.amazonaws.com
                      - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                      - lambda.amazonaws.com
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                Resource: "*"

  # 5. Logging delivery role for CloudFormation registry logs
  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-logging-delivery
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-logging-delivery
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: logging-delivery-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  # 6. CodeBuild and EKS service integration role
  CodeBuildEKSIntegrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-codebuild-eks-integration
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks-integration
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: codebuild-eks-integration-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
                  - eks:DescribeAddon
                  - eks:ListAddons
                Resource: "*"

  # 7. CloudFormation extension hooks role
  CFNHooksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-cfn-hooks
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-hooks
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: hooks.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-hooks-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: eks:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:PutBucketAcl
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:*
                Resource: "*"

  # 8. Bastion instance role
  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-bastion-instance
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bastion-instance-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:BatchGetProjects
                  - codebuild:ListBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListProjects
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:StopBuild
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:StopPipelineExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  # Instance profile for the bastion role
  BastionInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-bastion-instance-profile
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref BastionInstanceRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Comprehensive SQS infrastructure with FIFO queues, DLQs, KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms'

Parameters:
  QueueNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: TestQueue

Resources:
  # KMS Key for encrypting all queues
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7

  QueueEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${QueueNamePrefix}-sqs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey

  # FIFO queue without DLQ
  FifoQueueNoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-no-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  # FIFO queue with DLQ
  FifoQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoQueueDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 3

  # DLQ for the FIFO queue with DLQ
  FifoQueueDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  # Standard queue with DLQ
  StandardQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardQueueDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # DLQ for the standard queue
  StandardQueueDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  # Separate FIFO DLQ
  SeparateFifoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  # CloudWatch Alarms - all with actions enabled set to false

  # Standard queue: NumberOfMessagesSent as sum, threshold 1, breaching on missing data
  AlarmStandardMessagesSent:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-messages-sent
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when standard queue messages sent sum exceeds 1'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # FIFO queue with DLQ: NumberOfMessagesSent average with anomaly detection
  AlarmFifoWithDLQMessagesSentAnomaly:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: 'Anomaly detection alarm for average messages sent on FIFO queue with DLQ'
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Metrics:
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: 'Anomaly Detection Band'
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Stat: Average
            Period: 300

  # Standard queue: SentMessageSize max, threshold 183500
  AlarmStandardSentMessageSize:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when standard queue sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Separate FIFO queue: SentMessageSize max, threshold 183500
  AlarmSeparateFifoSentMessageSize:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-separate-fifo-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when separate FIFO queue sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Standard DLQ: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible sum > 0
  AlarmStandardDLQVisibleMessages:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when standard DLQ has visible messages'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # FIFO DLQ: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible sum > 0
  AlarmFifoDLQVisibleMessages:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when FIFO DLQ has visible messages'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Standard queue: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage max, threshold 15
  AlarmStandardOldestMessageAge:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when standard queue oldest message age exceeds 15 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Separate FIFO queue: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage max, threshold 15
  AlarmSeparateFifoOldestMessageAge:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-separate-fifo-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when separate FIFO queue oldest message age exceeds 15 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Standard queue: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible max, threshold 108000
  AlarmStandardNotVisibleMessages:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-not-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when standard queue not visible messages exceeds 108000'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Separate FIFO queue: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible max, threshold 18000
  AlarmSeparateFifoNotVisibleMessages:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-separate-fifo-not-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when separate FIFO queue not visible messages exceeds 18000'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Standard DLQ: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage max, threshold 90
  AlarmStandardDLQOldestMessageAge:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when standard DLQ oldest message age exceeds 90 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # Synthetic always-OK alarm - not breaching on missing data
  AlarmSyntheticAlwaysOK:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-synthetic-always-ok
      AlarmDescription: 'Synthetic always-OK alarm'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'ROSA Private Networking Infrastructure with AWS PrivateLink'

Parameters:
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    AllowedValues: [1, 3]
    Description: Number of Availability Zones for the ROSA VPC subnets (1 or 3)

  RosaVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the ROSA VPC

  RosaSubnetAz1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA subnet in Availability Zone 1

  RosaSubnetAz2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA subnet in Availability Zone 2 (used only when NumberOfAZs is 3)

  RosaSubnetAz3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA subnet in Availability Zone 3 (used only when NumberOfAZs is 3)

  EgressVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC

  EgressPublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC public subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC private subnet

  CreateELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: false
    AllowedValues: [true, false]
    Description: Whether to create the AWS Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role

  EnableVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: false
    AllowedValues: [true, false]
    Description: Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs

Conditions:
  IsMultiAZ: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]
  ShouldCreateELBRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateELBServiceLinkedRole, true]
  ShouldEnableFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpcFlowLogs, true]

Resources:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA VPC
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc

  RosaSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnetAz1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-subnet-az1

  RosaSubnetAz2:
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnetAz2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-subnet-az2

  RosaSubnetAz3:
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnetAz3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-subnet-az3

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress VPC
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-subnet

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-igw

  IGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateway with Elastic IP
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    DependsOn: NatEIP
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    DependsOn: TransitGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-route-table

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway VPC Attachments
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaVpcTgwAttachment:
    DependsOn: TransitGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaSubnetAz1
        - !If [IsMultiAZ, !Ref RosaSubnetAz2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        - !If [IsMultiAZ, !Ref RosaSubnetAz3, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-tgw-attachment

  EgressVpcTgwAttachment:
    DependsOn: TransitGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-tgw-attachment

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway Route Table Associations
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaVpcTgwAssociation:
    DependsOn: TransitGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaVpcTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressVpcTgwAssociation:
    DependsOn: TransitGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressVpcTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway Routes
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TgwRouteToInternet:
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressVpcTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwRouteToRosa:
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaVpcTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress VPC Route Tables and Routes
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-rt

  EgressPublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: IGWAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicRouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-rt

  EgressPrivateRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateRouteToRosa:
    DependsOn: EgressVpcTgwAttachment
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateRouteTableAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA VPC Route Tables and Routes (AZ 1)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaRouteTableAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-az1-rt

  RosaRouteAz1Default:
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTgwAttachment
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaRouteAz1ToEgress:
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTgwAttachment
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaSubnetAz1Assoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz1
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnetAz1

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA VPC Route Tables and Routes (AZ 2) - conditional
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-az2-rt

  RosaRouteAz2Default:
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTgwAttachment
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaRouteAz2ToEgress:
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTgwAttachment
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaSubnetAz2Assoc:
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz2
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnetAz2

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-az3-rt

  RosaRouteAz3Default:
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTgwAttachment
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaRouteAz3ToEgress:
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTgwAttachment
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz3
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaSubnetAz3Assoc:
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTableAz3
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnetAz3

  # ELB Service-Linked Role (optional)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Condition: ShouldCreateELBRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs Infrastructure (optional)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdminPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-lg

  FlowLogsRole:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc-flow-log

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc-flow-log

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PCI DSS Remediation Automation Prerequisites and SSM Automation Documents
  for Config Conformance Packs

Parameters:
  CloudTrailCWLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/cloudtrail/cloudwatch-logs
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/pci-dss-cloudtrail-key
    Description: Alias for the KMS CMK used for CloudTrail encryption
  SSMAutomationRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: pci-dss-ssm-automation-role
    Description: Name of the IAM role for SSM automations to assume
  CloudTrailCWLogsRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: pci-dss-cloudtrail-cw-logs-role
    Description: Name of the IAM role for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs Log Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailCWLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: KMS Customer Master Key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for CloudTrail encryption (PCI DSS)
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-policy-pci-dss
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable Root Account Access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  CloudTrailKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KMSKeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: IAM Role for SSM Automations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SSMAutomationRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

        description: Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default security

        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to

            default: ''
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group to clean

        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeRulesResult
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: revoke_security_group_rules
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def revoke_security_group_rules(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=context.get('region_name'))
                    group_id = events['GroupId']

                    sg_response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    sg = sg_response['SecurityGroups'][0]

                    ip_permissions = sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    ip_permissions_egress = sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])

                    ingress_count = 0
                    egress_count = 0

                    if ip_permissions:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions
                        )
                        ingress_count = len(ip_permissions)

                    if ip_permissions_egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions_egress
                        )
                        egress_count = len(ip_permissions_egress)

                    return {
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'IngressRulesRevoked': ingress_count,
                        'EgressRulesRevoked': egress_count
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:

      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment
          variables from a CodeBuild project
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to
              perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to update
        outputs:
          - RemoveCredentialsResult.Result
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveCredentialsResult
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: remove_credential_env_vars
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import copy

                def remove_credential_env_vars(events, context):
                    cb = boto3.client('codebuild', region_name=context.get('region_name'))
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']

                    response = cb.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    if not response['projects']:
                        raise Exception(f'Project {project_name} not found')

                    project = response['projects'][0]
                    env = copy.deepcopy(project['environment'])

                    original_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    filtered_vars = [
                        v for v in original_vars
                        if v['name'] not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
                    ]

                    if len(filtered_vars) == len(original_vars):
                        return {
                            'ProjectName': project_name,
                            'Status': 'NO_CHANGES_NEEDED',
                            'Message': 'No credential environment variables found'
                        }

                    env['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars
                    cb.update_project(name=project_name, environment=env)

                    removed_count = len(original_vars) - len(filtered_vars)
                    return {
                        'ProjectName': project_name,
                        'Status': 'CREDENTIALS_REMOVED',
                        'RemovedCount': removed_count,
                        'Message': f'Removed {removed_count} credential environment variable(s)'
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap
