final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained bootstrap environment for deploying AWS CDK applications.
  Creates an encrypted S3 bucket with versioning and HTTPS-only access,
  an immutable ECR repository with image scanning, a KMS key with
  customizable alias, IAM roles for publishing, deployment, and account
  lookup, and an SSM parameter for version tracking.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Short qualifier string to uniquely identify stack components in the
      same AWS account and region.
    Default: cdkb
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Description: Version identifier for the bootstrap deployment.
    Default: '1.0.0'
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Alias prefix for the KMS key. The full alias becomes 'alias/<value>'.
    Default: cdk-assets-key
  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ID (key ID, key ARN, alias name, or alias ARN) of an existing KMS key
      to use for S3 bucket encryption instead of creating a new one.
      Leave empty to create a new KMS key.
    Default: ''
  AssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Custom name for the S3 asset bucket. Leave empty to auto-generate a name
      based on the qualifier and account ID.
    Default: ''
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of AWS principal ARNs that can assume the IAM
      roles (e.g. 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root,arn:aws:iam::210987654321:root').
      Leave empty to restrict to the current account only.
    Default: ''
  ManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of IAM managed policy ARNs to attach to the
      cloudformation-execution role
      (e.g. 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess').
      Leave empty for no additional managed policies.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  CreateKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, '']
  UseCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AssetBucketName, '']]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TrustedAccounts, '']]
  HasManagedPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagedPolicyArns, '']]

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  # =========================================================================
  CdkAssetsKmsKey:
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false
      Description: !Sub 'KMS encryption key for CDK bootstrap ${Qualifier} assets'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # =========================================================================
  # KMS Alias
  # =========================================================================
  CdkAssetsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${KmsKeyAlias}'
      TargetKeyId: !If [CreateKmsKey, !Ref CdkAssetsKmsKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId]

  # =========================================================================
  # S3 Asset Bucket
  # =========================================================================
  CdkAssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseCustomBucketName
        - !Ref AssetBucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [CreateKmsKey, !Ref CdkAssetsKmsKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId]
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # =========================================================================
  # HTTPS-Only Bucket Policy
  # =========================================================================
  CdkAssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CdkAssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${CdkAssetBucket}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${CdkAssetBucket}'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': false

  # =========================================================================
  # ECR Container Repository (immutable, scan on push)
  # =========================================================================
  CdkContainerRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # =========================================================================
  # SSM Parameter for Bootstrap Version
  # =========================================================================
  CdkBootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap version for qualifier ${Qualifier}'

  # =========================================================================
  # IAM Role — File Publishing
  # =========================================================================
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Qualifier}-file-publishing'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [',', !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root,${TrustedAccounts}']
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: file-publishing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${CdkAssetBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${CdkAssetBucket}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateKmsKey
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${CdkAssetsKmsKey}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${ExistingKmsKeyId}'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # =========================================================================
  # IAM Role — Image Publishing
  # =========================================================================
  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Qualifier}-image-publishing'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [',', !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root,${TrustedAccounts}']
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: image-publishing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${CdkContainerRepository}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # =========================================================================
  # IAM Role — Account Lookup
  # =========================================================================
  AccountLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Blue-Green Elastic Beanstalk Deployment Template - Supports creating new or referencing existing blue application/environment, with optional temporary green environment for traffic routing during updates"

Parameters:
  BlueDeployType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - CreateNew
      - UseExisting
    Default: CreateNew
    Description: "Whether to create a new application and environment or reference existing ones for the blue deployment"

  BlueAppName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenApp
    Description: "Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application for the blue deployment"

  BlueEnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: blue-env
    Description: "Name of the blue environment"

  CreateGreenEnv:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Whether to create a temporary green environment for traffic routing during updates"

  GreenEnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: green-env
    Description: "Name of the temporary green environment"

  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: "64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.12.0 running Node.js 22"
    Description: "Solution stack name for the Elastic Beanstalk environments"

  SampleAppBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: iac-god-eval-sample-1793499553
    Description: "S3 bucket containing the sample application. When the default value is used, the current region is appended to the bucket name"

  SampleAppKey:
    Type: String
    Default: working-sample.zip
    Description: "S3 key for the sample application archive"

  InstanceProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: EBProfile-BlueGreenApp
    Description: "Name of the IAM instance profile to use for the Elastic Beanstalk environment"

Conditions:
  CreateNewBlue: !Equals [!Ref BlueDeployType, "CreateNew"]
  CreateGreen: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnv, "true"]
  UseDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref SampleAppBucket, "elasticbeanstalk-samples"]

Resources:

    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref BlueAppName
      Description: "Blue application for Blue-Green deployment strategy"

  BlueApplicationVersion:
    Condition: CreateNewBlue
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    DependsOn:
      - BlueApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref BlueAppName
      Description: "Sample application version for the blue environment"
      SourceBundle:

        S3Key: !Ref SampleAppKey

  EBVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"

      EnableDnsHostnames: true

    Properties:

      AvailabilityZone: !Sub "${AWS::Region}b"

    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties: {}

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EBVPC

      GatewayId: !Ref EBInternetGateway

    Properties:

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EBSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref EBRouteTable

    Properties:

      EnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref BlueApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: AWSServiceRoleForElasticBeanstalk
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:command
          OptionName: IgnoreHealthCheck
          Value: "true"
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfileName
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref EBVPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref EBSubnet1, !Ref EBSubnet2]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref EBSubnet1, !Ref EBSubnet2]]

  GreenApplicationVersion:
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref BlueAppName
      Description: "Application version for the green environment"
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If [UseDefaultBucket, !Sub "${SampleAppBucket}-${AWS::Region}", !Ref SampleAppBucket]
        S3Key: !Ref SampleAppKey

  GreenEnvironment:
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    DependsOn:
      - EBSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - EBSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref BlueAppName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref GreenApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: AWSServiceRoleForElasticBeanstalk
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:command
          OptionName: IgnoreHealthCheck
          Value: "true"
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfileName
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref EBVPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref EBSubnet1, !Ref EBSubnet2]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref EBSubnet1, !Ref EBSubnet2]]

Outputs:

    Condition: CreateNewBlue
    Description: "URL of the blue environment"
    Value: !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL

    Condition: CreateNewBlue
    Description: "Name of the blue environment"

    Condition: CreateGreen

    Value: !Ref GreenEnvironment

              Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
              Properties:
                InstanceType: ml.t2.medium
                RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerRole.Arn
                SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId
                DirectInternetAccess: Disabled
          Outputs:
            NotebookInstanceName:
              Value: !Ref NotebookInstance"""

          TMPL_TP = """AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
          Description: Third-party ML model product
          Parameters:
            EnvironmentPrefix:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            ModelBucket:
              Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
              Properties:
                BucketName: !Sub "DLR{EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-model-DLR{AWS::AccountId}"
          Outputs:
            BucketName:
              Value: !Ref ModelBucket"""

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      send_cfnresponse(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {})
                      return

                  bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['BucketName']

                  templates = {
                      'vpc-with-private-subnets-and-endpoints.yml': TMPL_VPC.replace('DLR', '$'),
                      'iam-roles-kms-keys-s3-buckets.yml': TMPL_IAM.replace('DLR', '$'),
                      'data-exchange-product.yml': TMPL_DX.replace('DLR', '$'),
                      'infrastructure-product.yml': TMPL_INFRA.replace('DLR', '$'),
                      'application-product.yml': TMPL_APP.replace('DLR', '$'),
                      'sagemaker-notebook-instance.yml': TMPL_SM,
                      'third-party-ml-model.yml': TMPL_TP.replace('DLR', '$')
                  }

                  s3 = boto3.client('s3')
                  urls = {}
                  for filename, content in templates.items():
                      s3.put_object(
                          Bucket=bucket,
                          Key=filename,
                          Body=content.encode('utf-8'),
                          ContentType='application/x-yaml'
                      )
                      region = os.environ.get('AWS_DEFAULT_REGION', 'us-east-1')
                      urls[filename] = f"https://{bucket}.s3.{region}.amazonaws.com/{filename}"

                  send_cfnresponse(event, context, 'SUCCESS', urls)
              except Exception as e:
                  send_cfnresponse(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)})

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Dual-stack VPC with public/private subnets, NACLs, placement group, and DHCP options"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: "Environment to deploy (staging or production)"

  DeployNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway for private subnet outbound IPv4 traffic"

Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: "10.0.0.0/16"
      DomainName: "staging.internal"
    production:
      VpcCidr: "10.1.0.0/16"
      DomainName: "production.internal"

Conditions:
  DeployNAT: !Equals [!Ref DeployNATGateway, "true"]

Resources:
  # VPC with DNS support
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-vpc"

  # IPv6 CIDR block for the VPC (Amazon-provided)
  VPCIPv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Egress-only Internet Gateway for IPv6
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # Public Subnet 1 (AZ1 - presentation/load balancer tier)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6Cidr
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr], 5, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Sub
        - "${H1}:${H2}:${H3}:${H4Base}00::/64"
        - H1: !Select [0, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H2: !Select [1, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H3: !Select [2, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H4Base: !Select [0, !Split ["00", !Select [3, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Public Subnet 2 (AZ1 - presentation/load balancer tier)
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6Cidr
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr], 5, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Sub
        - "${H1}:${H2}:${H3}:${H4Base}01::/64"
        - H1: !Select [0, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H2: !Select [1, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H3: !Select [2, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H4Base: !Select [0, !Split ["00", !Select [3, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Public Subnet 3 (AZ2 - compute/EC2 tier)
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6Cidr
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr], 5, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Sub
        - "${H1}:${H2}:${H3}:${H4Base}02::/64"
        - H1: !Select [0, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H2: !Select [1, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H3: !Select [2, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H4Base: !Select [0, !Split ["00", !Select [3, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Private Subnet 1 (AZ1 - application tier)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6Cidr
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr], 5, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Sub
        - "${H1}:${H2}:${H3}:${H4Base}03::/64"
        - H1: !Select [0, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H2: !Select [1, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H3: !Select [2, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H4Base: !Select [0, !Split ["00", !Select [3, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # Private Subnet 2 (AZ1 - data tier)
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6Cidr
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr], 5, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Sub
        - "${H1}:${H2}:${H3}:${H4Base}04::/64"
        - H1: !Select [0, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H2: !Select [1, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H3: !Select [2, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]
          H4Base: !Select [0, !Split ["00", !Select [3, !Split [":", !Select [0, !Split ["::", !Select [0, !Split ["/", !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]]]]]]]]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-rt"

  # Public route for IPv4 default traffic via Internet Gateway
  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public route for IPv6 default traffic via Internet Gateway
  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Associate public subnets with public route table
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-rt"

  # Private route for IPv6 via Egress-Only Internet Gateway
  PrivateRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  # Private route for IPv4 via NAT Gateway (conditional)
  PrivateRouteIPv4NAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: DeployNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  # Associate private subnets with private route table
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway resources (conditional)
  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: DeployNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-nat-eip"

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: DeployNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-nat-gw"

  # Public Network ACL
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-nacl"

  # Public NACL Inbound Rules

  # HTTP IPv4
  PublicNACLInHTTPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # HTTP IPv6
  PublicNACLInHTTPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # HTTPS IPv4
  PublicNaclInHTTPSv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # HTTPS IPv6
  PublicNACLInHTTPSv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # SSH IPv4
  PublicNACLInSSHv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  # SSH IPv6
  PublicNACLInSSHv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 121
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  # Bastion VPN (UDP 1194) IPv4
  PublicNACLInVPNv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  # Bastion VPN (UDP 1194) IPv6
  PublicNACLInVPNv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 131
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  # Ephemeral return traffic (TCP 1024-65535) IPv4
  PublicNACLInEphemeralv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Ephemeral return traffic (TCP 1024-65535) IPv6
  PublicNACLInEphemeralv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 141
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Public NACL Outbound Rules - open egress (TCP and UDP all ports)

  PublicNACLOutTCPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PublicNACLOutTCPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PublicNACLOutUDPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PublicNACLOutUDPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  # Private Network ACL - allow all inbound and outbound (TCP and UDP)

  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-nacl"

  PrivateNACLInTCPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PrivateNACLInTCPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PrivateNACLInUDPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PrivateNACLInUDPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PrivateNACLOutTCPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateNACLOutTCPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateNACLOutUDPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateNACLOutUDPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  # Associate NACLs with subnets
  PublicNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicNetworkAclAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnet1NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnet2NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  # EC2 Placement Group for tightly coupled workloads
  PlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-placement-group"

  # DHCP Options Set
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-dhcp-options"

  DHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

Outputs:
  VpcID:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-VpcID"

  VpcCidr:
    Description: "VPC CIDR block"
    Value: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless Movies API - Fully self-contained stack'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment name (used as API stage name)

Resources:

  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Table - pay-per-request, keyed on title
  # ============================================================
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'Movies-${Environment}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ============================================================
  # Shared IAM Role for Lambda functions
  # ============================================================
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'MoviesLambdaRole-${Environment}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCRUD
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # CloudWatch Log Groups - 1 day retention for each function
  # ============================================================
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/CreateMovie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/ReadMovie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/UpdateMovie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/DeleteMovie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda Functions - Python 3.12, 128MB, 30s timeout
  # ============================================================
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'CreateMovie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})}

              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return {'statusCode': 201, 'body': json.dumps(body)}
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMovieLogGroup
      - LambdaExecutionRole

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'ReadMovie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from decimal import Decimal

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          class DecimalEncoder(json.JSONEncoder):
              def default(self, obj):
                  if isinstance(obj, Decimal):
                      return float(obj)
                  return super().default(obj)

          def handler(event, context):
              title = event.get('pathParameters', {}).get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})}

              response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
              item = response.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return {'statusCode': 404, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Movie not found'})}
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps(item, cls=DecimalEncoder)}
    DependsOn:
      - ReadMovieLogGroup
      - LambdaExecutionRole

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'UpdateMovie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})}

              update_expression = 'SET '
              expression_attribute_values = {}
              expression_attribute_names = {}
              for key, value in body.items():
                  if key != 'title':
                      update_expression += f'#{key} = :{key}, '
                      expression_attribute_names[f'#{key}'] = key
                      expression_attribute_values[f':{key}'] = value

              if not expression_attribute_values:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'No attributes to update'})}

              update_expression = update_expression.rstrip(', ')
              table.update_item(
                  Key={'title': title},
                  UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                  ExpressionAttributeNames=expression_attribute_names,
                  ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps(body)}
    DependsOn:
      - UpdateMovieLogGroup
      - LambdaExecutionRole

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'DeleteMovie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})}

              table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': f'Movie {title} deleted'})}
    DependsOn:
      - DeleteMovieLogGroup
      - LambdaExecutionRole

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway REST API - Regional endpoint
  # ============================================================
  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MoviesAPI-${Environment}'
      Description: 'Movies REST API'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Resources
  # ============================================================
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  MoviesByTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Methods - /Movies resource
  # ============================================================
  MoviesPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MoviesPutMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MoviesDeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # CORS OPTIONS for /Movies - MOCK integration
  MoviesOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: false

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Methods - /Movies/{title} resource
  # ============================================================
  MoviesByTitleGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesByTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.title: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # CORS OPTIONS for /Movies/{title} - MOCK integration
  MoviesByTitleOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesByTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: false

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  SageMaker Studio domain, user profile (MLOps Engineer), and scoped IAM execution role.

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      Optional existing SageMaker Studio Domain ID. When supplied, VpcId, SubnetIds, and
      SecurityGroupIds must also be provided and no new VPC or Domain is created.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Existing VPC ID (required when DomainId is supplied).

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of subnet IDs (required when DomainId is supplied).

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of security group IDs (required when DomainId is supplied).

  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: The name of the SageMaker Studio user profile.

Conditions:
  CreateVpc:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref DomainId
      - ""
  CreateDomain:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref DomainId
      - ""

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and networking (only when no DomainId is provided)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-public-subnet

  PrivateSubnet:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-private-subnet

  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio domain
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-sg

  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-public-rt

  DefaultRoute:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  EIP:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-natgw

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-private-rt

  PrivateNatRoute:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio Domain (only when no DomainId is provided)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerStudioDomain:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: mlops-studio-domain
      AuthMode: IAM
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !Ref SecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Execution Role for the MLOps Engineer persona
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sagemaker-mlops-engineer-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerScopedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              # PassRole: allow SageMaker to pass the execution role
              - Sid: PassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/sagemaker-mlops-engineer-role
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

              # SageMaker Pipelines
              - Sid: SageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                Resource: "*"

              # Model Monitoring Schedules
              - Sid: ModelMonitoring
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: "*"

              # Models and Model Package Groups
              - Sid: SageMakerModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                Resource: "*"

              # Experiments, Trials, and Lineage
              - Sid: SageMakerExperiments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                Resource: "*"

              # Training, Transform, Processing, Hyperparameter Tuning
              - Sid: SageMakerJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                Resource: "*"

              # SageMaker Endpoints
              - Sid: SageMakerEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpointAsync
                Resource: "*"

              # Studio Applications and Spaces (ownership restriction via resource ARN)
              - Sid: SageMakerStudioApps
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                Resource:
                  - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${UserProfileName}
                  - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${UserProfileName}/*

              # S3: read/write access for MLOps workflows
              - Sid: S3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*/*

              # CloudWatch Logs (for training/processing job logs)
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

              # ECR (pull images for jobs)
              - Sid: ECR
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: "*"

      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio User Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateDomain
          - !Ref SageMakerStudioDomain
          - !Ref DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerUserProfile.UserProfileArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance benchmarks

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: db-encryption-benchmarks
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for benchmark results.
  ThroughputDataSize:
    Type: String
    Default: 1KB
    Description: Data size value to filter throughput benchmark events on.
  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period for the log group in days.

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays

  # ============================================================================
  # Java
  # ============================================================================
  JavaMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.benchmark_type = "memory" && $.language = "java" }'
      FilterName: java-memory-efficiency-ratio
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricValue: $.efficiency_ratio
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaPeakMemoryFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.benchmark_type = "memory" && $.language = "java" }'
      FilterName: java-peak-memory
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PeakMemoryUsage
          MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricValue: $.peak_memory_mb
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AppSync Todo API with JavaScript Pipeline Resolvers'

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: TodoAPIwithJs

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Table with GSI on owner attribute
  # ============================================================
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: TodoTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: OwnerIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ============================================================
  # AppSync GraphQL API with API Key authentication
  # ============================================================
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # ============================================================
  # API Key for authentication
  # ============================================================
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  # ============================================================
  # AppSync DataSource for DynamoDB
  # ============================================================
  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DataSourceRole.Arn

  DataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TodoDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*'

  # ============================================================
  # GraphQL Schema Definition
  # ============================================================
  GraphQLSchemaDef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos: [Todo]
          todosByOwner(owner: String!): [Todo]
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo(owner: String): Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo(owner: String): Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo(owner: String): Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  # ============================================================
  # JavaScript Functions for Pipeline Resolvers
  # ============================================================
  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: createTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const id = util.autoId();
          const { arguments: { input } } = ctx;
          const item = {
            id: { S: id },
            owner: { S: input.owner },
            title: { S: input.title },
            createdAt: { S: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
            updatedAt: { S: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' }
          };
          if (input.description) {
            item.description = { S: input.description };
          }
          return { operation: 'PutItem', key: item, table: 'TodoTable' };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource

  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: updateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { arguments: { input } } = ctx;
          const expr = 'SET #updatedAt = :updatedAt' +
            (input.owner ? ', #owner = :owner' : '') +
            (input.title ? ', #title = :title' : '') +
            (input.description ? ', #description = :description' : '');
          const exprNames = { '#updatedAt': 'updatedAt' };
          const exprValues = { ':updatedAt': { S: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' } };
          if (input.owner) { exprNames['#owner'] = 'owner'; exprValues[':owner'] = { S: input.owner }; }
          if (input.title) { exprNames['#title'] = 'title'; exprValues[':title'] = { S: input.title }; }
          if (input.description) { exprNames['#description'] = 'description'; exprValues[':description'] = { S: input.description }; }
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: { id: { S: input.id } },
            update: {
              expression: expr,
              expressionNames: exprNames,
              expressionValues: exprValues
            },
            table: 'TodoTable'
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource

  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: deleteTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { arguments: { id } } = ctx;
          return { operation: 'DeleteItem', key: { id: { S: id } }, table: 'TodoTable' };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource

  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: getTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { arguments: { id } } = ctx;
          return { operation: 'GetItem', key: { id: { S: id } }, table: 'TodoTable' };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource

  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: listTodosFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return { operation: 'Scan', table: 'TodoTable' };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource

  TodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: todosByOwnerFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { arguments: { owner } } = ctx;
          return {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: { ':owner': { S: owner } }
            },
            index: 'OwnerIndex',
            table: 'TodoTable'
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource

  # ============================================================
  # Pipeline Resolvers
  # ============================================================
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt CreateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-07-25",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
    DependsOn:
      - CreateTodoFunction
      - GraphQLSchemaDef

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt UpdateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-07-25",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
    DependsOn:
      - UpdateTodoFunction
      - GraphQLSchemaDef

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt DeleteTodoFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-07-25",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
    DependsOn:
      - DeleteTodoFunction
      - GraphQLSchemaDef

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetTodoFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-07-25",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
    DependsOn:
      - GetTodoFunction
      - GraphQLSchemaDef

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ListTodosFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-07-25",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
    DependsOn:
      - ListTodosFunction
      - GraphQLSchemaDef

  TodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: todosByOwner
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt TodosByOwnerFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-07-25",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
    DependsOn:
      - TodosByOwnerFunction
      - GraphQLSchemaDef
