AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM roles for the Data Master project data pipeline

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing KMS key used for raw data encryption
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:\\d{12}:key/[a-f0-9-]{36}$"
    Default: "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole policies
    AllowedPattern: "^\\d{12}$"
    Default: "123456789012"

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. DMS to Kinesis – allows DMS to write records into a Kinesis stream
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-kinesis
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsKinesisAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. DMS VPC role – restricted to the target account
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-vpc
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref TargetAccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsVpcManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. EventBridge Pipes → Firehose
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-pipes-firehose

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FirehosePutAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource: "*"

        - Key: Project

        - Key: Component

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application health monitoring

Parameters:
  RemittanceApiGatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: RemittanceApi
    Description: The name of the existing API Gateway REST API

  RemittanceApiGatewayStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: The deployment stage name for the API Gateway

  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: The name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function

  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: The name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function

  DbClusterInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: The identifier of the existing RDS DB instance

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # API GATEWAY METRIC ALARMS
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-4XXErrors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when 4XX errors average above 0 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiGatewayName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiGatewayStageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-5XXErrors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when 5XX errors average above 1 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiGatewayName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiGatewayStageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-Latency
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when latency is at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiGatewayName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiGatewayStageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAMBDA METRIC ALARMS
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # GetRemittances Errors
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Errors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when GetRemittances errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # CreateRemittance Errors
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Errors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when CreateRemittance errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # GetRemittances Invocations
  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Invocations
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when GetRemittances invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # CreateRemittance Invocations
  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Invocations
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when CreateRemittance invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # GetRemittances Duration
  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Duration
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when GetRemittances average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # CreateRemittance Duration
  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Duration
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when CreateRemittance average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS METRIC ALARMS
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  RdsHighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-HighCPU
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DatabaseConnections
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS database connections are at or above 100 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Deadlocks
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS deadlocks are at or above 10 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS network transmit throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS network receive throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Queries
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS queries are at or above 100 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DiskQueueDepth
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS disk queue depth is at or above 50 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-ReadLatency
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS read latency is at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-WriteLatency
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when RDS write latency is at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbClusterInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # COMPOSITE ALARMS
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for API Gateway health - triggered when any API Gateway metric alarm is in ALARM
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3})"
        - Alarm1: !Ref ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm
          Alarm2: !Ref ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm
          Alarm3: !Ref ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for Lambda health - triggered when any Lambda errors or duration alarm is in ALARM
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3}) OR ALARM(${Alarm4})"
        - Alarm1: !Ref GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm
          Alarm2: !Ref CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm
          Alarm3: !Ref GetRemittancesDurationAlarm
          Alarm4: !Ref CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for RDS health - triggered when any RDS metric alarm is in ALARM
      AlarmRule:
        Fn::Join:
          - " OR "
          - - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsHighCpuAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsDeadlocksAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsQueriesAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsReadLatencyAlarm})"
            - !Sub "ALARM(${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm})"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Comprehensive monitoring and data extraction pipeline for QuickSight admin console'

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketPath:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-suite-scripts
    Description: S3 bucket path where Glue job scripts are stored

Resources:
  # S3 Bucket for all output - private, all public access blocked, Retain
  AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for Admin Suite S3 bucket encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  # Bucket Policy to enforce HTTPS only
  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AdminSuiteBucket}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AdminSuiteBucket}'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # Single IAM Role assumable by Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose, CloudWatch Metric Streams
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: admin-suite-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # S3 permissions for reading scripts and writing output
              - Sid: S3ReadScripts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketPath}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketPath}'
              - Sid: S3WriteOutput
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
              # QuickSight read permissions
              - Sid: QuickSightRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolder
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:DescribeTheme
                  - quicksight:DescribeAccountSubscription
                  - quicksight:DescribeAccountSettings
                  - quicksight:DescribeIngestion
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopic
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicRefresh
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicRefreshSchedule
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:ListFolderMembers
                  - quicksight:ListFolders
                  - quicksight:ListIngestions
                  - quicksight:ListTemplates
                  - quicksight:ListThemes
                  - quicksight:ListTopics
                  - quicksight:ListTopicRefreshSchedules
                  - quicksight:SearchAnalyses
                  - quicksight:SearchDashboards
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSets
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSources
                  - quicksight:SearchFolders
                  - quicksight:SearchTopics
                Resource: '*'
              # Glue permissions
              - Sid: GlueActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                Resource: '*'
              # Firehose permissions for Metric Streams to write
              - Sid: FirehosePutRecord
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              # KMS permissions for S3 bucket encryption key operations
              - Sid: KMSEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
              # CloudWatch Logs for Glue jobs
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole

  # ============================================================
  # GLUE JOBS - 5 Python Shell (Python 3.9, Glue 3.0)
  # ============================================================

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  # ============================================================
  # GLUE JOBS - 2 ETL (G.1X, 2 workers, Glue 5.0)
  # ============================================================

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketPath}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account-id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  # ============================================================
  # GLUE TRIGGERS - Scheduled every 3 hours
  # ============================================================

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_folder_assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_q_metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_q_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess

  TriggerDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_ds_properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_datasource_properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_assets_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_assets_metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

  # ============================================================
  # KINESIS FIREHOSE DELIVERY STREAMS - DirectPut -> S3
  # ============================================================

  FirehoseIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-ingestion
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight-ingestion/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: '!{firehose:error-output-type}/quicksight-ingestion-errors/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseVisual:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-visual
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight-visual/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: '!{firehose:error-output-type}/quicksight-visual-errors/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseSpice:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-spice
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight-spice/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: '!{firehose:error-output-type}/quicksight-spice-errors/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-quickindex
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight-quickindex/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: '!{firehose:error-output-type}/quicksight-quickindex-errors/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  FirehoseAction:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-action
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: quicksight-action/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: '!{firehose:error-output-type}/quicksight-action-errors/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # CLOUDWATCH METRIC STREAMS - JSON output to Firehose
  # ============================================================

  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: metric-stream-quicksight-ingestion
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIngestion.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount

  MetricStreamVisual:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: metric-stream-quicksight-visual
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseVisual.Arn

          MetricNames:

  MetricStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: metric-stream-quicksight-spice
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseSpice.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  MetricStreamQuickIndex:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Kitten CRUD API - Self-contained serverless service using API Gateway and DynamoDB

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Table with on-demand billing
  # ============================================================
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ============================================================
  # IAM Role for API Gateway to call DynamoDB
  # ============================================================
  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway REST API
  # ============================================================
  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenApi
      Description: CRUD API for Kitten service
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # ============================================================
  # Request validation model and validator for POST and PUT
  # ============================================================
  KittenRequestModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Description: Schema for create/update Kitten request body
      Schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - name
          - color
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
          color:
            type: string

  KittenRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: false

  # ============================================================
  # Gateway Responses — add CORS headers to all error responses
  # ============================================================
  GatewayResponse4xx:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: DEFAULT_4XX
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

  GatewayResponse5xx:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: DEFAULT_5XX
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

  # ============================================================
  # Resources
  # ============================================================
  # /kitten
  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Step Functions state machine with a single pass state, version, alias, and event-driven triggers (API Gateway, EventBridge rules, EventBridge Scheduler)"

Resources:

  # ==============================================================================
  # STEP FUNCTIONS STATE MACHINE
  # ==============================================================================
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: "PassStateMachine"
      StateMachineType: "STANDARD"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          {
            "Comment": "A single pass state machine that returns result 1",
            "StartAt": "PassState",
            "States": {
              "PassState": {
                "Type": "Pass",
                "Result": {"result": 1},
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: "Initial version"

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: "live"
      Description: "Alias pointing to the initial version"
      DeploymentPreference:
        Type: ALL_AT_ONCE
        StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion

  # ==============================================================================
  # API GATEWAY REST API
  # ==============================================================================
  ApiGatewayApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: "sf-trigger-api"
      Description: "REST API to trigger Step Functions execution via alias"

  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "execute"

  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri:
          Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json:
            Fn::Sub: |
              {
                "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}",
                "input": "{}"
              }
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: "200"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: "200"

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayApi
      Description: "Deployment"
      StageName: "prod"

  # ==============================================================================
  # EVENTBRIDGE RULE — MATCHES TERMINATED STATE CHANGES
  # ==============================================================================
  EventRuleTerminated:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: "terminated-state-changes"
      Description: "Matches Step Functions terminal state changes and starts an execution"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.states"
        detail-type:
          - "Step Functions Execution Status Change"
        detail:
          status:
            - "SUCCEEDED"
            - "FAILED"
            - "TIMED_OUT"
            - "ABORTED"
      Targets:
        - Id: "StartExecution"
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRuleTerminatedRole.Arn
      State: ENABLED

  # ==============================================================================
  # EVENTBRIDGE RULE — SCHEDULED EVERY MINUTE (DISABLED)
  # ==============================================================================
  EventRuleScheduled:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: "scheduled-every-minute"
      Description: "Runs every minute but is initially disabled"
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(1 minute)"
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: "StartExecution"
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRuleScheduledRole.Arn

  # ==============================================================================
  # EVENTBRIDGE RULE — RESPONDS TO TAG EVENTS FROM AWS TAG SERVICE
  # ==============================================================================
  EventRuleTags:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: "tag-events"
      Description: "Responds to tag events from the AWS Tag service"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.tag"
        detail-type:
          - "Tag Change"
      Targets:
        - Id: "StartExecution"
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRuleTagsRole.Arn
      State: ENABLED

  # ==============================================================================
  # EVENTBRIDGE SCHEDULER SCHEDULE — EVERY MINUTE, FLEXIBLE TIME WINDOWS OFF
  # ==============================================================================
  SchedulerSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Name: "every-minute-schedule"
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(1 minute)"
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: "OFF"
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn

  # ==============================================================================
  # IAM ROLES — STATE MACHINE EXECUTION ROLE + EACH TRIGGER HAS ITS OWN ROLE
  # ==============================================================================
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "state-machine-exec-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ApiGatewayRole:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM identities and permission policies required by the Cluster API Provider
  AWS (CAPA) bootstrap process for a cluster that uses Amazon EKS

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CUSTOMER-MANAGED IAM POLICIES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Policy for the control-plane role: EC2, Auto Scaling, LB, KMS
  # (legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider). Attached to the control plane role.
  ControlPlaneCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: capa-control-plane-cloud-provider
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyPair
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'

  # Policy for control-plane and nodes: EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM
  # (cluster nodes register and pull images). Attached to both roles.
  ClusterNodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: capa-cluster-nodes
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:List*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeImages
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:ListImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
              - secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: '*'

  # Policy for controllers and control-plane: EC2 networking, Auto Scaling,
  # LB, launch template, service-linked-role
  # (Cluster API controllers manage cluster infrastructure). Attached to both roles.
  ControllersInfraPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: capa-controllers-infrastructure
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:PassedToService': 'eks.amazonaws.com'

  # Policy for controllers and control-plane: EKS clusters, node groups,
  # add-ons, Fargate profiles, IAM, KMS. Attached to both roles.
  ControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: capa-controllers-eks
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:UpdateRole
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:CreatePolicy
              - iam:DeletePolicy
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:ListPolicies
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:GetPublicKey
            Resource: '*'

  # Standalone read-only EKS policy (intended for human users/groups,
  # not attached to any role by this template)
  ReadOnlyEKSGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: capa-eks-read-only

  ReadOnlyEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: capa-read-only-eks
      Groups:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyEKSGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:ListUpdates
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:DescribeInsight
              - eks:ListInsights
            Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM ROLES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  # EKS control plane role (assumable by EKS service)
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy

  # Control plane role (assumable by EC2)
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  # Nodes role (assumable by EC2)
  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  # Controllers role (assumable by EC2 and EKS pods)
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-controllers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # INSTANCE PROFILES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  NodesProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ControllersProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'General purpose networking foundation with VPC, NAT gateways, endpoints, and flow logs'

Parameters:
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in first availability zone
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in second availability zone
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in first availability zone
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in second availability zone
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period for flow logs in days
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in flow logs

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Networking Foundation VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['0', !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Public Subnet AZ1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['1', !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Public Subnet AZ2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['0', !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private Subnet AZ1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['1', !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private Subnet AZ2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC Internet Gateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NAT Gateway EIP AZ1

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NAT Gateway EIP AZ2

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - NatEIP1
          - AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NAT Gateway AZ1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - NatEIP2
          - AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NAT Gateway AZ2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Public Route Table

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private Route Table AZ1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private Route Table AZ2

  PublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn:
      - VPCGatewayAttachment

  PrivateRouteDefault1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRouteDefault2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PublicSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Join ['', ['com.amazonaws.', !Ref 'AWS::Region', '.s3']]
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC Endpoints SG

  EndpointSecurityGroupInboundHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidrBlock

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Join ['', ['com.amazonaws.', !Ref 'AWS::Region', '.ecr.api']]
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDockerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Join ['', ['com.amazonaws.', !Ref 'AWS::Region', '.ecr.dkr']]
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC Flow Logs

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteFlowLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC infrastructure for KerberosEMRonEKS with Microsoft AD support'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/26'
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.64/26'
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.128/26'
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.192/26'
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 2
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period for CloudWatch logs in days

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PublicSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Public-Subnet-1
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PublicSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Public-Subnet-2
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - PublicSubnet1
          - AvailabilityZone
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-Subnet-1
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - PublicSubnet2
          - AvailabilityZone
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-Subnet-2
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      InternetGatewayId:
        Ref: InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Public-RouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId:
        Ref: InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PublicRouteTable

  NATEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-EIP-1

  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn:
      - PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - NATEIP1
          - AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-Gateway-1

  NATEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-EIP-2

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn:
      - PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - NATEIP2
          - AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NAT-Gateway-2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-RouteTable-1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId:
        Ref: NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-Private-RouteTable-2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId:
        Ref: NATGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable2

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-policy-flowlog
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLog-KMS-Key

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogLogGroup}:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLog-Role

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/kerberos-emr-on-eks-flow-logs
      RetentionInDays:
        Ref: LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - KMSKey
          - Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLog-LogGroup

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId:
        Ref: VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogLogGroup}
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - FlowLogRole
          - Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC-FlowLog

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Restricts inbound and outbound HTTPS traffic to VPC CIDR
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp:
            Ref: VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp:
            Ref: VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoint-SG

  SSMVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet1
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - Ref: VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMMessagesVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet1
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - Ref: VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2MessagesVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet1
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - Ref: VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SecretsManagerVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet1
        - Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - Ref: VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value:
      Ref: VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value:
      Ref: PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value:
      Ref: PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value:
      Ref: PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value:
      Ref: PrivateSubnet2
