AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained SageMaker Domain configured in VPC Only mode with a single test
  user profile, a dedicated execution role with full SageMaker management
  permissions, and a default S3 bucket.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain.
    Default: studio-domain
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.

  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the single test user profile in the SageMaker Domain.
    Default: test-user
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.

  DefaultS3BucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of the default S3 bucket for the domain. Leave empty to use the S3
      bucket created by this template.
    Default: ""

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      VPC ID for the SageMaker Domain. Leave empty to use the VPC created by this
      template.
    Default: ""

  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of subnet IDs for the SageMaker Domain (at least two
      subnets in different Availability Zones). Leave empty to use the subnets
      created by this template.
    Default: ""

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of security group IDs for the SageMaker Domain.
      Leave empty to use the security group created by this template.
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  UseCreatedBucket: !Equals [!Ref DefaultS3BucketArn, ""]
  UseCreatedVpc: !Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]
  UseCreatedSubnets: !Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, ""]
  UseCreatedSecurityGroups: !Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupIds, ""]
  IsUserProvidedBucketArn: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Select [0, !Split [":", !Ref DefaultS3BucketArn]]
      - "arn"

Resources:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (used when no VPC / subnet / security group parameters supplied)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-vpc"

  SageMakerSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-subnet-a"

  SageMakerSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-subnet-b"

  SageMakerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: SageMaker Domain VPC-only mode security group.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow traffic within the VPC only.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-sg"

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key and default S3 bucket (used when no bucket ARN parameter supplied)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DefaultBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseCreatedBucket
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the default SageMaker domain bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DefaultBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseCreatedBucket
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-bucket"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DefaultBucketKey

  DefaultBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: UseCreatedBucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DefaultBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DefaultBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: UseCreatedBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DefaultBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DefaultBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${DefaultBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution role
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${TestUserName}-execution-role"
      Description: Execution role for the SageMaker Studio test user profile.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                - sagemaker-data-science-assistant.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerFullManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerJobAndExperimentManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DisassociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SageMakerModelAndArtifactManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SageMakerStudioAppManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:ListDomains
                  - sagemaker:UpdateUserProfile
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DefaultBucketReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - UseCreatedBucket
                    - !GetAtt DefaultBucket.Arn
                    - !Ref DefaultS3BucketArn
                  - !If
                    - UseCreatedBucket
                    - !Sub "${DefaultBucket.Arn}/*"
                    - !Sub "${DefaultS3BucketArn}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  SageMakerExecutionRolePassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: PassRoleToSageMakerServices
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassRoleToSageMakerServices
            Effect: Allow
            Action: "iam:PassRole"
            Resource: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "iam:PassedToService": "sagemaker.amazonaws.com"

  SageMakerExecutionRoleBucketKeyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseCreatedBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: DefaultBucketKmsAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: UseDefaultBucketKey
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: !GetAtt DefaultBucketKey.Arn

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Domain and test user profile
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - UseCreatedSecurityGroups
          - - !Ref SageMakerSecurityGroup
          - !Split [",", !Ref SecurityGroupIds]
        SharingSettings:
          NotebookOutputOption: Allowed
          S3OutputPath: !If
            - UseCreatedBucket
            - !Sub "s3://${DefaultBucket}/shared"
            - !If
              - IsUserProvidedBucketArn
              - !Join ["", ["s3://", !Select [5, !Split [":", !Ref DefaultS3BucketArn]], "/shared"]]
              - !Sub "s3://${DefaultS3BucketArn}/shared"
      SubnetIds: !If
        - UseCreatedSubnets
        - - !Ref SageMakerSubnetA
          - !Ref SageMakerSubnetB
        - !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      VpcId: !If [UseCreatedVpc, !Ref Vpc, !Ref VpcId]
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  TestUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - UseCreatedSecurityGroups
          - - !Ref SageMakerSecurityGroup
          - !Split [",", !Ref SecurityGroupIds]
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: The ID of the SageMaker Domain.
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId

  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: The name of the SageMaker execution role.
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole

  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio console for the new domain.
    Value: !Sub "https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/studio/${SageMakerDomain.DomainId}"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  A comprehensive collection of saved CloudWatch Logs Insights query definitions
  for analyzing usage, performance, and cost metrics generated by a Claude Code
  application. All queries are scoped to a single CloudWatch Logs log group,
  exposed as a parameter.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    AllowedPattern: "^[\\.\\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$"
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that contains the Claude Code
      metrics. All saved queries are scoped to this log group.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Real-time monitoring
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TokenRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Token rate per user (real-time)"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens
        | filter ispresent(user)
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens,
                sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens,
                sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
                count(*) as requests
                by user
        | sort total_tokens desc

  RequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Request rate per user (real-time)"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, request_id
        | filter ispresent(user)
        | stats count(*) as requests by user
        | sort requests desc

  CurrentTpmRpmAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Current TPM / RPM averages"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, total_tokens
        | stats sum(total_tokens) / 60 as tokens_per_minute,
                count(*) / 60 as requests_per_minute
        | sort tokens_per_minute desc

  RateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Rate-limit risk"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, total_tokens, status_code, error_code
        | filter ispresent(total_tokens)
        | stats max(total_tokens) as peak_tokens,
                count(*) as requests,
                sum(status_code = 429 or error_code = "rate_limit_exceeded") as rate_limit_errors
                by user
        | filter rate_limit_errors > 0
        | sort rate_limit_errors desc

  ActiveUsersNow:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Active users in the last hour"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user
        | filter ispresent(user)
        | stats count(*) as requests,
                max(@timestamp) as last_seen
                by user
        | sort last_seen desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User and session analytics
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Session-level usage"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, session_id, user, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd
        | filter ispresent(session_id)
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens,
                sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens,
                sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
                sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd,
                count(*) as requests,
                min(@timestamp) as session_start,
                max(@timestamp) as session_end
                by session_id, user
        | sort total_tokens desc

  HourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Hourly activity timeline"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, total_tokens
        | stats sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
                count(*) as requests
                by bin(1h), user
        | sort @timestamp asc

  ErrorThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Error and throttling detection"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, session_id, status_code, error_code, error_message
        | filter status_code >= 400 or error_code like /throttl/ or error_code like /rate_limit/
        | stats count(*) as errors by user, session_id, status_code, error_code
        | sort errors desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cost and attribution reporting
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Cost by user"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, cost_usd, total_tokens
        | filter ispresent(user)
        | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd,
                sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
                count(*) as requests
                by user
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  CostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Cost by model"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, cost_usd, total_tokens
        | filter ispresent(model)
        | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd,
                sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
                count(*) as requests
                by model
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  CostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Cost by organization"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, organization_id, cost_usd, total_tokens
        | filter ispresent(organization_id)
        | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd,
                sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
                count(*) as requests
                by organization_id
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Debugging and analysis
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Model efficiency"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, latency_ms
        | filter ispresent(model)
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens,
                sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens,
                avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms,
                sum(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd,
                count(*) as requests,
                sum(cost_usd) / sum(output_tokens) as cost_per_output_token
                by model
        | sort cost_per_output_token asc

  CacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Cache hit / miss rate (overall)"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens
        | stats sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as cache_hits,
                sum(cache_creation_input_tokens) as cache_creations
        | sort cache_hits desc

  CacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "[Claude Code] Cache hit / miss rate (over time)"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryLanguage: CWLI
      QueryString: |

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  AppSync GraphQL API "SuperCoolAPI" with AWS IAM authentication and CloudWatch
  Logs request logging, backed by a DynamoDB table "Table1" exposed through
  multiple data sources that reference the table and its region in different
  ways, with IAM roles and policies granting full read-write access to the
  table and its secondary indexes.

Parameters:
  AppSyncLoggingLevel:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch Logs field logging level for the GraphQL API.
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL
      - ERROR
      - INFO
      - DEBUG

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs: log group + role that AppSync assumes to write logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/appsync/apis/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppSyncLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AppSyncLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync API: AWS IAM auth + full request/response logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: !Ref AppSyncLoggingLevel
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GraphQL schema
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SuperCoolAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM service role assumed by AppSync to query Table1
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBTable1FullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBTableAndIndexesReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub "${Table1.Arn}/index/*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data source 1: table referenced by ARN via GetAtt (same-region default)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Table1DataSourceByArn:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1ByArn
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing Table1 by its ARN.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data source 2: table referenced by explicit name, current region
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Table1DataSourceByName:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1ByName
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing Table1 by physical name.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data source 3: region supplied through a nested Sub / map lookup
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Table1DataSourceBySub:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1BySub
      Description: DynamoDB data source with region and table built via Sub.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Sub "${Table1}"
        AwsRegion: !Sub
          - "${RegionName}"
          - RegionName: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolvers wiring the schema to the data sources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceByArn.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceByName.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  ApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
  ApiArn:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn
  GraphQLUrl:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl
  Table1Name:
    Description: DynamoDB table name.
    Value: !Ref Table1
  Table1Arn:
    Description: DynamoDB table ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt Table1.Arn

    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: First Availability Zone
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Second Availability Zone

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  # ── VPC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: emr-celeborn-vpc

  # ── Public Subnets (one per AZ) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: public-subnet-1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: public-subnet-2

  # ── Private Subnets (one per AZ) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-2

  # ── Internet Gateway ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: emr-celeborn-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ── Elastic IPs & NAT Gateways (one per AZ) ─────────────────────────────
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-az1

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-az2

  # ── Public Route Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: public-rt

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ── Private Route Table – AZ 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-rt-az1

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  # ── Private Route Table – AZ 2 ──────────────────────────────────────────
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-rt-az2

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ── S3 Gateway Endpoint (reachable from all route tables) ───────────────
  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ── Security Group for VPC Interface Endpoints ──────────────────────────
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS from the VPC CIDR to VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: vpc-endpoint-sg

  # ── VPC Interface Endpoints for AWS services ────────────────────────────
  SSMInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EC2InterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  CloudWatchLogsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  CloudWatchMonitoringInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  STSInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EMRInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  KMSInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ── KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs encryption ────────────────────────────────
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow root admin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow flow logs role
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: vpc-flow-logs-kms-key

  # ── CloudWatch Logs Group for Flow Logs ─────────────────────────────────
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ── IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs delivery ─────────────────────────────────
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: vpc-flow-logs-role

  # ── VPC Flow Log ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

    Value: !Ref VPC
  VpcCidr:

    Description: ID of the first public subnet

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with IPv4 and Amazon-provided IPv6 ranges, public/private subnets across 3 Availability Zones"

Parameters:
  Identifier:
    Type: String
    Description: A name identifier for the VPC
    Default: my-vpc
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to create public subnets with Internet Gateway
  Az1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: First Availability Zone
    Default: us-east-1a
  Az2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Second Availability Zone
    Default: us-east-1b
  Az3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Third Availability Zone
    Default: us-east-1c
  PublicSubnet0Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for public subnet in AZ1
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for public subnet in AZ2
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for public subnet in AZ3
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
  PrivateSubnet0Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for private subnet in AZ1
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for private subnet in AZ2
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for private subnet in AZ3
    Default: 10.0.5.0/24

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref CreatePublicSubnets
      - "true"

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC with IPv4 CIDR
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref Identifier

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon-provided IPv6 CIDR block for the VPC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcIpv6Block:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets (conditional)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet0:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az1
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet0Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - public-0

  PublicSubnet1:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az2
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - public-1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az3
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - public-2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets (always created)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az1
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet0Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - private-0

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az2
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - private-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az3
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - private-2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway and attachment (conditional)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - igw

  IGWAttachment:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table and default route (conditional)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Join:
              - "-"
              - - !Ref Identifier
                - public-rt

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet0Association:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM identities and permissions for Cluster API Provider for AWS"

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: capaws
    Description: Base name used to qualify all IAM resources created by this template.

Resources:

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM ROLES AND INSTANCE PROFILES
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------- Control Plane ----------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ---------- Controllers ----------
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  # ---------- Worker Nodes ----------
  WorkerNodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-worker-nodes-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []

  WorkerNodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-worker-nodes-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodesRole

  # ---------- EKS Control Plane ----------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-control-plane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []

  EKSControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-control-plane-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref EKSControlPlaneRole

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # BOOTSTRAPPER GROUP AND USER
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-bootstrapper-group"

  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-bootstrapper"
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # POLICIES
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Broader managed policy for controllers and control plane roles.
  # Covers EC2 networking, load balancing, auto scaling, EKS cluster and
  # nodegroup management, and service-linked role creation.
  BroaderControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers-broader-policy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref ControllersRole
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:GetConsoleOutput
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
              - autoscaling:PutNotificationConfiguration
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:PassRole
              - eks:UpdateCluster
              - eks:UpdateNodegroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
              - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
              - iam:GetInstanceProfile
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: "*"

  # Cloud Provider Core policy granting EC2, Elastic Load Balancing, Auto
  # Scaling, ECR, Secrets Manager, and Systems Manager (SSM) permissions.
  CloudProviderCorePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-cloud-provider-core-policy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref WorkerNodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - ecr:*
              - secretsmanager:*
              - ssm:*
            Resource: "*"

  # EKS Cluster Policy – mirrors the AWS managed AmazonEKSClusterPolicy.
  EKSClusterPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-cluster-policy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref EKSControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  # EKS Service Policy – mirrors the AWS managed AmazonEKSServicePolicy.
  EKSServicePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-service-policy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref EKSControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:ec2:::vpc/*
              - arn:aws:ec2:::subnet/*

  # Worker Node Policy – mirrors the AWS managed AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy.

    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-worker-node-policy"
      Roles:

      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - eks:DescribeCluster
            Resource: "*"

              - ec2:DescribeInstances

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience – deployable in any AWS region with configurable NAT Gateway setup'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used as a prefix for resource names
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - PerAZ
    Description: >
      Single – one NAT Gateway in the first Availability Zone (cost-effective).
      PerAZ – a NAT Gateway in every public-subnet Availability Zone (high availability).

Conditions:
  IsSingleNat:
    !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, Single]
  IsPerAzNat:
    !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, PerAZ]

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  VPC
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Internet Gateway
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Public Subnets  (10.0.101.0/24 … 10.0.103.0/24)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - '0'
          - - !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}d'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}e'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - '1'
          - - !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}d'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}e'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - '2'
          - - !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}d'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}e'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Private Subnets  (10.0.1.0/24 … 10.0.3.0/24)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - '0'
          - - !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}d'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}e'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - '1'
          - - !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}d'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}e'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - '2'
          - - !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}d'
            - !Sub '${AWS::Region}e'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Public Route Table  (shared by all public subnets)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Private Route Tables  (one per private subnet – needed for PerAZ NAT)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Single NAT Gateway  (cost-effective, one NAT for all private subnets)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEipSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'

  NatGatewaySingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEipSingle.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'

  PrivateRouteSingleToNat1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewaySingle

  PrivateRouteSingleToNat2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewaySingle

  PrivateRouteSingleToNat3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewaySingle

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  Per‑AZ NAT Gateways  (high availability – one NAT per AZ)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEipPerAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGatewayPerAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEipPerAz1.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGatewayEipPerAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGatewayPerAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEipPerAz2.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  NatGatewayEipPerAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGatewayPerAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEipPerAz3.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-3'

  PrivateRoutePerAzToNat1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayPerAz1

  PrivateRoutePerAzToNat2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayPerAz2

  PrivateRoutePerAzToNat3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayPerAz3

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  IAM Role for VPC Flow Log delivery
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:*:*:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flow-logs-role'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #  VPC Flow Logs  (7‑day retention, CloudWatch Logs destination)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flow-logs'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-flow-log'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Stack Outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 (AZ 2)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: Public subnet 3 (AZ 3)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 (AZ 2)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private subnet 3 (AZ 3)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  NatGatewayId:
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Description: NAT Gateway ID (Single mode)
    Value: !Ref NatGatewaySingle

  NatGateway1Id:
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for Availability Zone 1
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayPerAz1
  NatGateway2Id:
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for Availability Zone 2
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayPerAz2
  NatGateway3Id:
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for Availability Zone 3
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayPerAz3
