AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application. The VPC has
  no direct internet access (no internet gateway, no NAT gateway) and reaches AWS
  services exclusively through VPC endpoints. Includes three private subnets across
  multiple availability zones, interface and gateway VPC endpoints (Bedrock, ECR,
  CloudWatch Logs/Monitoring, DynamoDB, RDS Data API, Secrets Manager, SSM, KMS,
  S3 and X-Ray), VPC Flow Logs for all traffic encrypted with a customer-managed
  KMS key with automatic rotation, and dedicated security groups for the Agent
  Runtime, MCP Runtime and Lambda components with HTTPS-only egress to the VPC
  endpoints (plus direct DynamoDB access).

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC - fully isolated, no internet gateway / NAT
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-vpc"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Three private subnets spread across three availability zones
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.32.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-3"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single private route table shared by the three private subnets.
  # It has only the implicit VPC local route plus the routes that the S3 and
  # DynamoDB gateway endpoints attach (via RouteTableIds below).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security group attached to the interface VPC endpoints. Permits HTTPS only

  # endpoints; it never allows traffic outside the VPC.

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC

  EcrApiEndpoint:

    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  RdsDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface

    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC

      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  XRayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway VPC endpoints. Attaching them to the private route table creates the
  # local routes to the S3 and DynamoDB service ranges; no internet path exists.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDBEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed prefix lists describing the AWS service ranges that the
  # S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints route to. They are used as the egress
  # destination of the application security groups so that HTTPS traffic to the
  # gateway endpoints is explicitly permitted without opening egress to the
  # whole internet. In this isolated VPC those ranges are only reachable through
  # the gateway endpoints.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3EgressPrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:
      PrefixListName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-s3-egress"
      AddressFamily: IPv4
      MaxEntries: 20
      Entries:
        - Cidr: 16.15.156.0/22
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 16.15.160.0/19
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 16.15.192.0/18
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 16.182.0.0/16
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 18.34.0.0/19
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 18.34.232.0/21
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 3.5.0.0/19
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 52.216.0.0/15
          Description: S3
        - Cidr: 54.231.0.0/16
          Description: S3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-s3-egress"

  DynamoDBEgressPrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:
      PrefixListName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-egress"
      AddressFamily: IPv4
      MaxEntries: 20
      Entries:
        - Cidr: 3.218.180.0/23
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 3.218.182.0/24
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 35.71.68.0/23
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 35.71.70.0/24
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 35.71.76.0/23
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 35.71.78.0/24
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 52.119.224.0/20
          Description: DynamoDB
        - Cidr: 52.94.0.0/22
          Description: DynamoDB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-egress"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key (automatic rotation enabled) used to encrypt the
  # VPC Flow Logs.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-kms"

  FlowLogKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encrypted CloudWatch Log Group that receives the VPC Flow Log records
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role that lets VPC Flow Logs deliver records to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsToCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs - capture ALL traffic, delivered to the KMS-encrypted group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      LogFormat: "${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-log"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dedicated security group per application component.
  # Egress is HTTPS-only, restricted to the private VPC (interface endpoints)
  # and to the S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints through their service ranges.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Agent Runtime component - HTTPS-only egress to the VPC endpoints and DynamoDB
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3EgressPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to the S3 gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDBEgressPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to the DynamoDB gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-agent-runtime-sg"

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: MCP Runtime component - HTTPS-only egress to the VPC endpoints and DynamoDB
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3EgressPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to the S3 gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDBEgressPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to the DynamoDB gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-mcp-runtime-sg"

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Lambda functions - HTTPS-only egress to the VPC endpoints and DynamoDB
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3EgressPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to the S3 gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDBEgressPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to the DynamoDB gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-sg"

    Description: ID of the isolated application VPC
    Value: !Ref ApplicationVPC
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Description: Private subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
  FlowLogKMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for the Agent Runtime component

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for the MCP Runtime component
    Value: !Ref McpRuntimeSecurityGroup

    Description: Security group for Lambda functions
    Value: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC and networking resources for Amazon EKS, spanning three Availability Zones

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    Description: Name tag applied to VPC and related resources
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in Availability Zone 1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in Availability Zone 2
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in Availability Zone 3
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in Availability Zone 1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in Availability Zone 2
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.13.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in Availability Zone 3
  CustomTcpPort1:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8443
    Description: Custom TCP port exposed on the application security group (e.g. service mesh webhook)
  CustomTcpPort2:
    Type: Number
    Default: 9443
    Description: Custom TCP port exposed on the application security group (e.g. Envoy admin)
  CustomTcpPort3:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15021
    Description: Custom TCP port exposed on the application security group (e.g. Istio health checks)
  CustomTcpPort4:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15001
    Description: Custom TCP port exposed on the application security group (e.g. Istio inbound)
  CustomTcpPort5:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15006
    Description: Custom TCP port exposed on the application security group (e.g. Istio inbound exclude)

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-igw

  VpcGatewayAttachment:

      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-public-3
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

        - Key: Name

      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-private-3
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:

      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${VpcName}-nat-3

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

        - Key: Name

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::LanguageExtensions
Description: >-
  Creates the IAM execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated
  with an Amazon EKS cluster, including EKS CNI permissions, ENI management
  permissions scoped to the provided subnets, security groups, and VPC, ECR pull
  access, CloudWatch alarm access, EKS Pod Identity access, lifecycle script S3
  bucket access, and optional RIG (Remote Interactive Gateway) policies. All
  created resources are tagged as SageMaker HyperPod prerequisites.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Prefix used to name the IAM execution role. The role name is composed by
      appending 'ExecRole' to this prefix.
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Amazon EKS cluster the SageMaker HyperPod cluster runs on.
    Default: hyperpod-eks-cluster
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: ID of the VPC in which the SageMaker HyperPod cluster runs.
    Default: vpc-0123456789abcdef0
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Description: >-
      List of private subnet IDs of the VPC that the SageMaker HyperPod cluster
      will use.
    Default: 'subnet-0123456789abcdef0'
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Description: >-
      List of security group IDs of the VPC that the SageMaker HyperPod cluster
      will use.
    Default: 'sg-0123456789abcdef0'
  LifecycleScriptsS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      S3 bucket name that stores the lifecycle scripts used by the SageMaker
      HyperPod cluster.
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-lifecycle-scripts
  RigInputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional S3 bucket used as the RIG (Remote Interactive Gateway) input
      bucket. Used only when CreateRigResources is set to true.
    Default: ''
  RigOutputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional S3 bucket used as the RIG (Remote Interactive Gateway) output
      bucket.
    Default: ''
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Description: Flag indicating whether to create the RIG resources.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'false'
      - 'true'
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Description: Flag indicating whether gated access to the SageMaker HyperPod cluster is enabled.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'false'
      - 'true'

Conditions:
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputS3Bucket, '']]
  EnableGatedAccess: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  RigS3OutputBucketProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputS3Bucket, '']]

Resources:
  SageMakerHyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-eks-cni-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EksCniDescribePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksCniTagNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-eni-ecr-and-controller-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEniResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${VpcId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
              - Sid: DescribeNetworkingResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GetContainerImageAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PullContainerImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: DescribeCloudWatchAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AssumeEksPodIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EksClusterName}'
              - Sid: ReadLifecycleScriptsBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsS3Bucket}'
              - Sid: GetLifecycleScriptsObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsS3Bucket}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: sagemaker-hyperpod-prerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}RigPolicy'
      Description: >-
        Permissions for the SageMaker HyperPod RIG (Remote Interactive Gateway).
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ListRigInputBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputS3Bucket}'
          - Sid: GetRigInputObjects
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputS3Bucket}/*'
          - Sid: InvokeSageMakerLambdaFunctions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccess
            - Sid: GatedS3AccessPointAndBucketGet
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccess
            - Sid: GatedSageMakerSqsMessageActions
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - RigS3OutputBucketProvided
            - Sid: RigOutputBucketReadWriteDelete
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  Fn::ForEach::SageMakerHyperPodSubnetEniPolicies:
    - SubnetId
    - !Ref SubnetIds
    - "SageMakerHyperPodSubnetPolicy&{SubnetId}":
        Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
        Properties:
          ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}SubnetEniPolicy-${SubnetId}'
          Description: >-
            ENI management permissions scoped to a private subnet used by the
            SageMaker HyperPod cluster.
          Roles:
            - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EniManagementActionsOnSubnet
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${SubnetId}'

  Fn::ForEach::SageMakerHyperPodSecurityGroupEniPolicies:
    - SecurityGroupId
    - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
    - "SageMakerHyperPodSecurityGroupPolicy&{SecurityGroupId}":
        Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
        Properties:
          ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}SecurityGroupEniPolicy-${SecurityGroupId}'
          Description: >-
            ENI management permissions scoped to a security group used by the
            SageMaker HyperPod cluster.
          Roles:
            - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EniManagementActionsOnSecurityGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for common operational personas.

Parameters:
  TagEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment tag value for tagging resources.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # SHARED CONDITION STMT: MFA required, deny billing, deny logging KMS tampering
  ############################################################################
  # This is a reusable policy document snippet used in multiple managed policies.
  # We define it as a separate managed policy that other policies reference via
  # policy statement inclusion where possible, but since IAM policy referencing
  # is limited, we'll inline the common statements into each policy.

  ############################################################################
  # MANAGED POLICIES
  ############################################################################

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. SystemAdministratorPolicy - near-full access outside IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: SystemAdministratorPolicy
      Description: Grants near-full access to AWS services except IAM, with MFA requirement and billing/KMS logging protection.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllServicesExceptIam
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction:
              - iam:*
              - organizations:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:UpdateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - iam:ListUsers
              - iam:ListGroups
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
              - tax:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
              StringEquals:
                kms:KeyManager: AWS

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. IamAdministratorPolicy - full IAM access
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IamAdministratorManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: IamAdministratorPolicy
      Description: Grants full IAM access with MFA requirement and billing/KMS logging protection.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFullIamAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:UpdateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - iam:ListUsers
              - iam:ListGroups
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
              - tax:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
              StringEquals:
                kms:KeyManager: AWS

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. InstanceOperationsPolicy - EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling, deny VPC networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceOperationsManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: InstanceOperationsPolicy
      Description: Grants EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling access while denying VPC networking modifications, with MFA and billing/KMS protection.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2Operations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:RebootInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
              - ec2:GetConsoleOutput
              - ec2:GetConsoleScreenshot
              - ec2:MonitorInstances
              - ec2:UnmonitorInstances
              - ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile
              - ec2:DisassociateIamInstanceProfile
              - ec2:ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation
              - ec2:CreateImage
              - ec2:DeregisterImage
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
              - ec2:CreateKeyPair
              - ec2:DeleteKeyPair
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
              - ec2:ImportKeyPair
              - ec2:CreateSnapshot
              - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
              - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
              - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupReferences
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElbOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:*
              - logs:*
              - events:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAutoScalingOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyVpcNetworkingModifications
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:ModifySecurityGroupRules
              - ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:RejectVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpnConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnGateway
              - ec2:DeleteVpnGateway
              - ec2:AttachVpnGateway
              - ec2:DetachVpnGateway
              - ec2:CreateCustomerGateway
              - ec2:DeleteCustomerGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:UnassignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreatePlacementGroup
              - ec2:DeletePlacementGroup
              - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
              - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
              - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
              - ec2:CreateManagedPrefixList
              - ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList
              - ec2:DeleteManagedPrefixList
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration
              - ec2:CreateTransitGateway
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGateway
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateFleet
              - ec2:DeleteFleet
              - ec2:ModifyFleet
              - ec2:CreateSpotDatafeedSubscription
              - ec2:DeleteSpotDatafeedSubscription
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:UpdateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - iam:ListUsers
              - iam:ListGroups
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
              - tax:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
              StringEquals:
                kms:KeyManager: AWS

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy - broad read-only across core services
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReadOnlyAdministratorManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy
      Description: Grants broad read-only access across core services with MFA requirement and billing/KMS logging protection.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadOnlyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:Get*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Get*
              - cloudwatch:List*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:Get*
              - logs:List*
              - s3:Get*
              - s3:List*
              - s3:Describe*
              - rds:Describe*
              - rds:Get*
              - rds:List*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - dynamodb:Get*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - lambda:Get*
              - lambda:List*
              - sns:Get*
              - sns:List*
              - sqs:Get*
              - sqs:List*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:List*
              - cloudformation:Describe*
              - cloudformation:Get*
              - cloudformation:List*
              - cloudtrail:Describe*
              - cloudtrail:Get*
              - cloudtrail:List*
              - config:Describe*
              - config:Get*
              - config:List*
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - organizations:Describe*
              - organizations:List*
              - acm:Describe*
              - acm:Get*
              - acm:List*
              - ssm:Describe*
              - ssm:Get*
              - ssm:List*
              - secretsmanager:Describe*
              - secretsmanager:Get*
              - secretsmanager:List*
              - route53:Get*
              - route53:List*
              - route53:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - iam:ChangePassword
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:UpdateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - iam:ListUsers
              - iam:ListGroups
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:GetUser
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - payments:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
              - tax:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
              StringEquals:
                kms:KeyManager: AWS

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. ReadOnlyBillingPolicy - billing read-only
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReadOnlyBillingManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyBillingPolicy
      Description: Grants read-only access to billing information.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadOnlyBilling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:ViewBilling
              - aws-portal:ViewUsage
              - aws-portal:ViewPaymentMethods
              - billing:Get*
              - billing:List*
              - billing:Describe*
              - payments:Get*
              - payments:List*
              - payments:Describe*
              - consolidatedbilling:Get*
              - consolidatedbilling:List*
              - tax:Get*
              - tax:List*
            Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # IAM GROUPS
  ############################################################################

  SystemAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdministrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorManagedPolicy

  IamAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IamAdministrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IamAdministratorManagedPolicy

  InstanceOperationsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOperations
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsManagedPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyAdministrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorManagedPolicy

  ReadOnlyBillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyBilling
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingManagedPolicy

  ############################################################################
  # IAM ROLES (EC2-assumable) and INSTANCE PROFILES
  ############################################################################

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # System Administrator Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SystemAdministrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref TagEnvironment

  SystemAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: SystemAdministrator
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Administrator Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IamAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: IamAdministrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IamAdministratorManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref TagEnvironment

  IamAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: IamAdministrator
      Roles:
        - !Ref IamAdministratorRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance Operations Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceOperationsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOperations
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref TagEnvironment

  InstanceOperationsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: InstanceOperations
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Read-Only Administrator Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReadOnlyAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyAdministrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref TagEnvironment

  ReadOnlyAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ReadOnlyAdministrator
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Read-Only Billing Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReadOnlyBillingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyBilling
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref TagEnvironment

  ReadOnlyBillingInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ReadOnlyBilling
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingRole

############################################################################
# OUTPUTS
############################################################################

Outputs:
  SystemAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: ID of the System Administrator group
    Value: !Ref SystemAdministratorGroup

  IamAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: ID of the IAM Administrator group
    Value: !Ref IamAdministratorGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC with web, application, and database tiers across three Availability Zones

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  WebSubnetCIDRs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24,10.0.1.0/24,10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR blocks for web-tier subnets (one per AZ, comma-separated)

  AppSubnetCIDRs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24,10.0.11.0/24,10.0.12.0/24
    Description: CIDR blocks for application-tier subnets (one per AZ, comma-separated)

  DbSubnetCIDRs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 10.0.20.0/24,10.0.21.0/24,10.0.22.0/24
    Description: CIDR blocks for database-tier subnets (one per AZ, comma-separated)

  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Number of Availability Zones to use (2 or 3)

Conditions:
  HasAz3:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref NumberOfAZs
      - 3

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web-tier subnets
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - !Ref WebSubnetCIDRs
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'web-subnet-${AWS::Region}a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - !Ref WebSubnetCIDRs
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'web-subnet-${AWS::Region}b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasAz3
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - !Ref WebSubnetCIDRs
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'web-subnet-${AWS::Region}c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # Web-tier route table (shared across all web subnets)
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: web-route-table

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasAz3
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway resources - one per AZ, in the web-tier subnet
  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-eip-az1

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-az1

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-eip-az2

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-az2

  NatGatewayEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: HasAz3
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-eip-az3

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: HasAz3
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-az3

  # Application-tier subnets
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - !Ref AppSubnetCIDRs
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'app-subnet-${AWS::Region}a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - !Ref AppSubnetCIDRs
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'app-subnet-${AWS::Region}b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab environment VPC with web and application tiers, VPC endpoints for S3, Kinesis Data Firehose, and Kinesis Data Streams

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-vpc

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  WebSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  WebSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  AppSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  AppSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier security group allowing inbound HTTPS from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt [VPC, CidrBlock]

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:GetObject'
            Resource: '*'

  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: Web tier subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: Web tier subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: Application tier subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: Application tier subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Web tier security group ID
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
