AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Shared per-account IAM roles and instance profiles for multi-cluster Amazon EKS deployments driven by CloudFormation custom resources backed by Lambda functions. Creates scoped Lambda execution roles for each custom-resource handler task plus the standard EKS control plane, Fargate, and worker node roles/profiles."

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "eks-infra"
    Description: "Common name prefix applied to all resource, role, and profile names."
  ConfigPath:
    Type: String
    Default: "/eks/config/"
    Description: "Common Systems Manager parameter path used by the SSM resolver handler."

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles for custom-resource handlers (each scoped narrowly)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Copies deployment assets between S3 buckets.
  LambdaS3CopyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-s3-copy"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-s3-copy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectAttributes
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"

  # Reads arbitrary AWS resources (read-only discovery across services).
  LambdaResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-resource-reader"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-resource-reader"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListPolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:GetPolicy
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ListKeys
                  - kms:ListAliases
                Resource: "*"

  # Creates (and manages) the VPC-related IAM role used by cluster VPC resources.
  LambdaVpcRoleCreatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-vpc-role-creator"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-vpc-role-creator"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"

  # Deletes the contents of S3 buckets.
  LambdaS3CleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-s3-cleanup"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-s3-cleanup"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: "*"

  # Cleans up orphaned load balancers plus their dependent security groups and
  # network interfaces after cluster teardown.
  LambdaLbCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-lb-cleanup"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lb-cleanup"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                Resource: "*"

  # Cleans up leftover Lambda functions.
  LambdaCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-cleanup"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-cleanup"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:ListVersionsByFunction
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: "*"

  # Looks up the calling identity.
  LambdaIdentityLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-identity-lookup"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-identity-lookup"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:ListUsers
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                Resource: "*"

  # Registers CloudFormation resource provider types and associated custom resources.
  LambdaResourceTypeRegistrarRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-resource-type-registrar"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-resource-type-registrar"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                Resource: "*"

  # Resolves Systems Manager parameters under a common configuration path.
  LambdaSsmResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-ssm-resolver"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-ssm-resolver"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ConfigPath}*"

  # Creates the IAM role that CloudFormation itself assumes when provisioning
  # cluster VPC resources.
  LambdaCfnVpcRoleCreatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-lambda-cfn-vpc-role-creator"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Prefix}-cfn-vpc-role-creator"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS cluster, Fargate, and worker node roles / instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # IAM role for the EKS control plane with the standard EKS managed policies.
  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-eks-control-plane"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy

  # IAM role that Fargate profiles assume.
  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-fargate-profile"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # IAM role for managed worker nodes plus matching instance profile.
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Prefix}-managed-node"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained IAM user and group configuration with an automatically
  generated Secrets Manager secret. The IAM user's username and console login
  password are resolved directly from the username and password keys of the
  generated secret.

Parameters:
  ID:
    Type: String
    Default: "999hadvhgchjesr"
    Description: Identifier used to name the IAM group.

Resources:
  Secret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}-secret"
      Description: "Minesweeper user secret"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 15
        ExcludeCharacters: '|;,."<>%`'
        ExcludePunctuation: false
        ExcludeUppercase: false
        ExcludeLowercase: false
        ExcludeNumbers: false
        RequireEachIncludedType: true

  SecretReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecretReaderCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: SecretReaderGetSecretValue
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref Secret

  SecretReaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SecretReaderRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import time
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None,
                            physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              response_body = {
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or (
                      "See the details in CloudWatch Log Stream: "
                      + context.log_stream_name
                  ),
                  "PhysicalResourceId":
                      physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {},
              }
              encoded = json.dumps(response_body).encode("utf-8")
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=encoded,
                  headers={"Content-Type": ""},
                  method="PUT",
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
                  response.read()


          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              secret_id = props.get("SecretId")
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", secret_id)

              if request_type == "Delete":
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS",
                                physical_resource_id=physical_id)
                  return

              try:
                  client = boto3.client("secretsmanager")
                  secret_string = None
                  for attempt in range(10):
                      try:
                          reply = client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_id)
                          secret_string = reply.get("SecretString")
                      except ClientError:
                          secret_string = None
                      if secret_string:
                          break
                      if attempt < 9:
                          time.sleep(2)

                  if not secret_string:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          "Unable to read the generated secret value"
                      )

                  payload = json.loads(secret_string)
                  username = payload.get("username")
                  password = payload.get("password")

                  if not username or not password:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          "Secret must contain 'username' and 'password' keys"
                      )

                  send_response(
                      event,
                      context,
                      "SUCCESS",
                      data={"Username": username, "Password": password},
                      physical_resource_id=physical_id,
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  send_response(
                      event,
                      context,
                      "FAILED",
                      physical_resource_id=physical_id,
                      reason=str(exc),
                  )

  SecretReader:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretReaderFunction.Arn
      SecretId: !Ref Secret

  UserGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MinesweeperFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                Resource: "*"

  User:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !GetAtt SecretReader.Username
      Groups:
        - !Ref UserGroup
      LoginProfile:
        Password: !GetAtt SecretReader.Password
        PasswordResetRequired: false

Outputs:
  UserArn:
    Description: ARN of the created IAM user
    Value: !GetAtt User.Arn

Description: >-
  Multi-account AWS Transit Gateway network hub with AWS Resource Access Manager
  sharing. Deployed in the primary transit account it creates the Transit
  Gateway and shares it; deployed in a spoke account it resolves the shared
  Transit Gateway through a reference function custom resource.

Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: ReferenceFunctions
    Description: >-
      Name of the stack that provides the Transit Gateway reference function
      used when this template is deployed into a spoke account.

  CompanyName:
    Type: String
    Default: Camelz
    Description: Name of the company that owns this system.

  SystemName:
    Type: String
    Default: Prototype
    Description: Name of the system these resources belong to.

  AccountName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    Description: Logical name of the account this stack is deployed into.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    Description: Name of the environment (used in resource descriptions and tags).

  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID of the transit gateway account.
    Description: >-
      Account ID of the primary transit gateway account. Leave empty when
      deployed in the transit gateway account, populate it when deployed in a
      spoke account.

  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: Private BGP ASN used by the transit gateway.

  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Whether the transit gateway automatically accepts shared attachments.

  DnsSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Whether DNS support is enabled on the transit gateway.

  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Whether VPN ECMP support is enabled on the transit gateway.

  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare
    Description: Name of the AWS RAM resource share that shares the transit gateway.

  Organization:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or an AWS Organizations organization ID.
    Description: >-
      AWS Organizations organization ID to share the transit gateway with.
      Leave empty to share with individual accounts only.

  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      Whether the resource share allows principals outside the organization.
      Automatically set to true when individual accounts are shared without an
      organization.

  OrganizationAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Account ID of the organization account.

  JumpstartAccount:

    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'

    Description: Account ID of the jumpstart account.

  ManagementAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Account ID of the AWS Organizations management account.

  LogAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Account ID of the log archive account.

    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.

    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.

  ProductionAccount:

    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Account ID of the production account.

  StagingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Account ID of the staging account.

    Type: String

    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'

Conditions:
  IsPrimaryTransitGatewayAccount: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, ""]
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref "AWS::AccountId"]

  IsSpokeAccount: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref "AWS::AccountId"]]

  HasOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Organization, ""]]

  HasOrganizationAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationAccount, ""]]

  HasJumpstartAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, ""]]

  HasManagementAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, ""]]

  HasLogAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, ""]]

  HasRecoveryAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, ""]]

  HasBuildAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, ""]]

  HasCoreAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, ""]]

  HasProductionAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, ""]]

  HasStagingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, ""]]

  HasUATAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, ""]]

  HasQAAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, ""]]

  HasTestingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, ""]]

  HasDevelopmentAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, ""]]

  HasCoreAccountGroup: !Or
    - !Condition HasOrganizationAccount
    - !Condition HasJumpstartAccount
    - !Condition HasManagementAccount
    - !Condition HasLogAccount
    - !Condition HasRecoveryAccount
    - !Condition HasBuildAccount
    - !Condition HasCoreAccount

  HasWorkloadAccountGroup: !Or
    - !Condition HasProductionAccount
    - !Condition HasStagingAccount
    - !Condition HasUATAccount
    - !Condition HasQAAccount
    - !Condition HasTestingAccount
    - !Condition HasDevelopmentAccount

  HasAnyIndividualAccount: !Or
    - !Condition HasCoreAccountGroup
    - !Condition HasWorkloadAccountGroup

  HasAnyTarget: !Or
    - !Condition HasOrganization
    - !Condition HasAnyIndividualAccount

  AllowExternalPrincipalsOption: !Equals [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, "true"]

  AllowExternalPrincipalsEnabled: !Or
    - !And
      - !Not [!Condition HasOrganization]
      - !Condition HasAnyIndividualAccount
    - !Condition AllowExternalPrincipalsOption

Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Description: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway"
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway"
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: AccountName
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If
        - AllowExternalPrincipalsEnabled
        - true
        - false
      Principals: !If
        - HasAnyTarget
        - - !If
            - HasOrganization
            - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${ManagementAccount}:organization/${Organization}"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If
            - HasOrganizationAccount
            - !Ref OrganizationAccount
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If
            - HasJumpstartAccount
            - !Ref JumpstartAccount
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If
            - HasManagementAccount
            - !Ref ManagementAccount
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If
            - HasLogAccount
            - !Ref LogAccount
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an IAM user and group with SES send permissions, an access key, and a
  Lambda-backed custom resource that converts the secret access key into an SES
  SMTP password, storing both as SecureString parameters in Systems Manager
  Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  IAMUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: Desired IAM user name (used as prefix for SSM parameter names)

  KeyRotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Version identifier to support rotating access keys without name collisions

  LambdaLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain Lambda CloudWatch logs

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key for encrypting SSM parameters.
      If left empty, the default AWS-managed key is used.

Conditions:
  UseCustomKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Group with SES send policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SESSendGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-Group'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SESSendPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM User
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SESUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUsername
      Groups:
        - !Ref SESSendGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Access Key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SESUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SESUser
      Status: Active

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Execution Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMParameterStoreWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${IAMUsername}/SMTPUsername'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${IAMUsername}/SMTPPassword'
              - !If
                - UseCustomKmsKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: kms:Encrypt
                  Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${IAMUsername}-SMTPCredentialConverter'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !If
        - UseCustomKmsKey
        - !Ref KmsKeyArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Function - SES SMTP Credential Converter
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SMTPCredentialConverterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-SMTPCredentialConverter'
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import base64
          import os

          SES_REGION = os.environ.get('SES_REGION', 'us-east-1')
          DATE = '11111111'
          SERVICE = 'ses'
          TERMINAL = 'aws4_request'
          MESSAGE = 'SendRawEmail'
          VERSION = 0x04

          def sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()

          def get_signature_key(key, date_stamp, region_name, service_name):
              k_date = sign(('AWS4' + key).encode('utf-8'), date_stamp)
              k_region = sign(k_date, region_name)
              k_service = sign(k_region, service_name)
              k_signing = sign(k_service, TERMINAL)
              return k_signing

          def convert_secret_to_smtp_password(secret_access_key):
              signing_key = get_signature_key(secret_access_key, DATE, SES_REGION, SERVICE)
              signature = sign(signing_key, MESSAGE)
              version_byte = bytes([VERSION])
              smtp_password_bytes = version_byte + signature
              return base64.b64encode(smtp_password_bytes).decode()

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType')
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  iam_username = props.get('IAMUsername', 'SMTPUser')
                  version = props.get('KeyRotationVersion', '1')
                  kms_key_arn = props.get('KmsKeyArn', '')

                  smtp_username_param = f'/{iam_username}/SMTPUsername'
                  smtp_password_param = f'/{iam_username}/SMTPPassword'

                  ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=SES_REGION)

                  if request_type == 'Create' or request_type == 'Update':
                      access_key_id = props.get('AccessKeyId', '')
                      if not access_key_id:
                          raise Exception('AccessKeyId must be passed as a ResourceProperty')

                      secret_access_key = props.get('SecretAccessKey', '')
                      if not secret_access_key:
                          raise Exception(
                              'SecretAccessKey must be passed as a ResourceProperty'
                          )

                      smtp_password = convert_secret_to_smtp_password(secret_access_key)

                      put_kwargs = {
                          'Name': smtp_username_param,
                          'Value': access_key_id,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True,
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          put_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_kwargs)

                      put_kwargs['Name'] = smtp_password_param
                      put_kwargs['Value'] = smtp_password
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_kwargs)

                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {
                              'SMTPUsername': access_key_id,
                              'SMTPUsernameParam': smtp_username_param,
                              'SMTPPasswordParam': smtp_password_param,
                          },
                          f'{iam_username}-smtp-credential-{version}'
                      )

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      for param in [smtp_username_param, smtp_password_param]:
                          try:
                              ssm.delete_parameter(Name=param)
                          except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                              pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})

                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})

              except Exception as e:
                  import traceback
                  traceback.print_exc()
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                                   {'Error': str(e)},
                                   event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'custom-resource-failed'))

      Environment:
        Variables:
          SES_REGION: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom Resource - invokes the Lambda to convert access key -> SMTP password
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SMTPCredentialCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::SMTPCredentialConverter
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SMTPCredentialConverterFunction.Arn
      IAMUsername: !Ref IAMUsername
      KeyRotationVersion: !Ref KeyRotationVersion
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SESUserAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SESUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      KmsKeyArn: !Ref KmsKeyArn

Outputs:
  IAMUsername:
    Description: IAM user name
    Value: !Ref SESUser

  SMTPUsernameSSMParameter:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path for the SMTP username (access key ID)
    Value: !Sub '/${IAMUsername}/SMTPUsername'

  SMTPPasswordSSMParameter:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path for the SMTP password
    Value: !Sub '/${IAMUsername}/SMTPPassword'

  AccessKeyId:
    Description: IAM access key ID (also the SMTP username)
    Value: !Ref SESUserAccessKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: WebSocket API for grant-processing job status updates - Python Lambda, DynamoDB, KMS

Resources:

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # DynamoDB table for tracking WebSocket connections (PAY_PER_REQUEST)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ConnectionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: grant-connections
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # KMS key for Lambda environment variable encryption
  # - Key rotation enabled
  # - Only the Lambda role and related functions may decrypt
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda environment variables (grant processor)
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: key-for-lambda-env
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowLambdaRoleDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # KMS key for CloudWatch log group encryption (separate key, no rotation)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LogGroupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CloudWatch log group encryption (API Gateway logs)
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: false
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: key-for-logs
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAdminUser
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # IAM role for Lambda execution
  # - Basic logging permissions
  # - DynamoDB read/write on connections table
  # - KMS Decrypt/Encrypt for env var key
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: grant-ws-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-logging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: dynamodb-connections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: kms-env-key
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Dedicated IAM role for API Gateway account-level CloudWatch logging
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ApiGatewayLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: grant-ws-apigw-logging-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: apigw-cloudwatch-logging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # CloudWatch log group for API Gateway access logs (encrypted with LogGroupKmsKey)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/apigateway/grant-ws-api
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # API Gateway account-level CloudWatch logging (uses V1 Account resource)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Python Lambda function that handles all WebSocket routes
  # - KmsKeyArn enables at-rest encryption of environment variables
  # - Code is packaged as a local zip file
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: grant-ws-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: ./grant_ws_handler.zip
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionTable
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # WebSocket API via API Gateway V2
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: grant-ws-api
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Lambda integration for the WebSocket API
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:grant-ws-handler"
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: "1.0"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Routes
  # - $connect:  client websocket handshake
  # - $disconnect:  client disconnect
  # - $default:  catch-all route
  # - send-status:  custom route for grant status updates
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates standard AWS IAM Identity Center permission sets for centralized
  administrative access control. The permission sets are only created when an
  IAM Identity Center instance ARN is supplied.

Parameters:
  InstanceArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance that owns the permission sets
      (for example arn:aws:sso:::instance/ssoins-1234567890abcdef). When left
      empty, no permission sets are created.
  DefaultSessionDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT12H
    Description: >-
      Session duration for the permission sets in ISO-8601 format (for example
      PT12H for twelve hours).
    AllowedPattern: "^P(\\d+Y)?(\\d+M)?(\\d+W)?(\\d+D)?(T(\\d+H)?(\\d+M)?(\\d+S)?)?$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an ISO-8601 duration, for example PT1H, PT8H or PT12H.
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: IdentityCenter
    Description: >-
      Prefix used for the logical names of the permission sets (for example
      IdentityCenter becomes IdentityCenterAdministrator).
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 15
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment the permission sets belong to.
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    Description: Key of the custom tag applied to the permission sets.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    Description: Value of the custom tag applied to the permission sets.
    MaxLength: 256

Conditions:
  HasInstanceArn: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref InstanceArn
      - ""

Resources:
  AdministratorPermissionSet:
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}Administrator"
      Description: Full administrative access to the AWS account.
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue

  PowerUserPermissionSet:
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}PowerUser"
      Description: >-
        Full access to AWS services except for management of users, groups and
        permissions.
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/PowerUserAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue

  OrganizationsFullPermissionSet:
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}OrganizationsFull"
      Description: Full access to AWS Organizations.
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSOrganizationsFullAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue

  ReadOnlyPermissionSet:
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}ReadOnly"
      Description: Read-only access to AWS services.
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue

Outputs:
  AdministratorPermissionSetArn:
    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Description: ARN of the administrator permission set.
    Value: !GetAtt AdministratorPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn

  PowerUserPermissionSetArn:
    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Description: ARN of the power user permission set.

    Value: !GetAtt OrganizationsFullPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn

    Condition: HasInstanceArn
    Description: ARN of the read-only permission set.
    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn

Description: >-
  Serverless webhook handler for Stripe/Squarespace sales notifications
  relayed to Slack via SNS.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SnsEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key

      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Description: KMS key for SNS topic encryption
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS topic – downstream consumers (e.g. a Slack app) subscribe to this
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SlackNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-slack-notifications"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SnsEncryptionKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role – allows the function to emit logs and publish to SNS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function – parses Stripe webhooks, queries Squarespace, publishes SNS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebhookHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SlackNotificationTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: >
          
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway REST API – exposes POST /webhooks
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayRestApi:

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy

  WebhookResource:

      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

---
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  On-demand DynamoDB orders table with an optional DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)
  caching cluster and the supporting VPC networking for lab testing.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: saa-lab-05
    Description: Prefix used to name the resources created by this stack.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only
      alphanumerics and hyphens.
  EnableDax:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    Description: >-
      Set to "true" to deploy the DAX cluster (and its subnet
      group and IAM role).
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  DaxReplicationFactor:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of DAX nodes in the cluster.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3

Conditions:
  DaxEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableDax
    - "true"

Resources:
  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-orders"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: false

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-vpc"

  PrimarySubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-subnet-1"

  SecondarySubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-subnet-2"

  ClientSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Client security group used to reach the DAX cluster.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-client-sg"

  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Allows DAX client traffic on TCP port 8111 from the
        client security group.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: DAX client traffic from the client security group.
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-sg"

  DaxSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-subnets"
      Description: Subnets used by the DAX cluster.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrimarySubnet
        - !Ref SecondarySubnet

  DaxRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-role"
      Description: >-
        Service role that lets the DAX cluster access the
        orders table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dax.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-dynamodb-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*"

  DaxCluster:
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax"
      NodeType: dax.t3.small
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxRole.Arn
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DaxSecurityGroup
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB orders table.
    Value: !Ref OrdersTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB orders table.
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
  DaxStatus:
    Description: Whether the DAX cluster is enabled.
    Value: !If
      - DaxEnabled
      - "enabled"
      - "disabled"
  ClientSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the DAX client security group.
    Value: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
  DaxDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: >-
      DAX cluster discovery endpoint, or "disabled" when DAX
      is not enabled.
    Value: !If
      - DaxEnabled

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:

          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      Tags:

          Value: "ResilienceTestSubnet1"

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr

        Fn::Select:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ResilienceTestSubnet2"

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group allowing traffic between resilience test subnets"

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ResilienceTestSG"

  SecurityGroupIngressFromSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress

      CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1Cidr

  SecurityGroupIngressFromSubnet2:

      AuthToken: !Ref AuthToken

        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref ElastiCacheSubnetGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        Statement:

        Statement:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "SSMAutomationPolicy"

            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:

                Resource: "*"

Resources:
  SongsApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SongsApi
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  SongsSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song!]!
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song!
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

        - AttributeName: id

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito User Pool with API Gateway REST API - authenticated GET /me and unauthenticated GET /open endpoints backed by a single Lambda function

Resources:
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Cognito User Pool
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Cognito User Pool Client (no secret)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-app-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Lambda Execution Role
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Lambda Function (shared by both endpoints)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  UserInfoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-info
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              claims = (
                  event
                  .get('requestContext', {})
                  .get('authorizer', {})
                  .get('claims', {})
              )

              if claims:
                  # Authenticated endpoint (/me)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'Authenticated request — your identity claims are below.',
                          'claims': claims,
                      }),
                  }

              # Unauthenticated endpoint (/open)
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'Unauthenticated request — no token required for this endpoint.',
                      'note': 'Compare this response with GET /me, which requires a valid access token.',
                  }),
              }

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. API Gateway REST API
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-api
      Description: REST API secured by Cognito User Pool Authorizer

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Cognito User Pool Authorizer for API Gateway
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  ApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7a. GET /me — protected by Cognito Authorizer
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UserInfoFunction.Arn}/invocations

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7b. GET /open — no authentication required
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UserInfoFunction.Arn}/invocations

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. API Gateway Deployment (prod stage)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod
      - OpenGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: prod

  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Lambda resource policy — allow API Gateway to invoke
  # -----------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaPermissionMe:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref UserInfoFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/me

  LambdaPermissionOpen:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref UserInfoFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/open
