    Description: Your marbot.io endpoint ID
    Default: 'placeholder'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid endpoint ID (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores)

  MarbotAwsAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID used by marbot.io to assume the cross-account monitoring role
    Default: '234026478547'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID

  EnableAutoMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and monitoring rules across resources

  EnableAccountAliasEnrichment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enrich account IDs with friendly aliases

  EnableMetricGraphEmbedding:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications

  EnableCodePipelineApproval:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests

Conditions:
  IsAutoMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAutoMonitoring, 'true']
  IsAccountAliasEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAccountAliasEnrichment, 'true']
  IsMetricGraphEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMetricGraphEmbedding, 'true']
  IsCodePipelineEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Resources:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge API Destination Connection (API key auth)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-connection-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: !Sub 'Connection to marbot.io endpoint ${MarbotEndpointId}'
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: Authorization
          ApiKeyValue: !Sub 'marbot-${MarbotEndpointId}'

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge API Destination
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-destination-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: !Sub 'API destination for marbot.io endpoint ${MarbotEndpointId}'
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn
      InvocationEndpoint: 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/accounts/connect'
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 10

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for EventBridge to invoke the API destination
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-events-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeApiDestination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scheduled Rule (every 30 days) – heartbeat / keep-alive
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotHeartbeatRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-heartbeat-${AWS::StackName}'
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(30 days)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotHeartbeatTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              eventTime: '$.time'
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "action": "heartbeat",
                "accountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stackId": "${AWS::StackId}",
                "stackName": "${AWS::StackName}",
                "endpointId": "${MarbotEndpointId}",
                "roleArn": "${MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn}",
                "externalId": "${AWS::StackId}",
                "timestamp": <eventTime>
              }

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cross-account IAM role that marbot's AWS account can assume
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-monitoring-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref MarbotAwsAccountId
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - IsAutoMonitoringEnabled
        - !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: marbot-monitoring-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - !If
                - IsAutoMonitoringEnabled
                -
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                    - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                    - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                    - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                    - events:DescribeRule
                    - events:ListRules
                    - events:ListTargetsByRule
                    - events:PutRule
                    - events:PutTargets
                    - events:RemoveTargets
                    - events:DeleteRule
                    - events:EnableRule
                    - events:DisableRule
                    - sns:ListTopics
                    - sns:Subscribe
                    - sns:Unsubscribe
                    - sns:GetTopicAttributes
                  Resource: '*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - IsAccountAliasEnabled
                -
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - iam:ListAccountAliases
                  Resource: '*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - IsMetricGraphEnabled
                -
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  Resource: '*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - IsCodePipelineEnabled
                -
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codepipeline:ListPipelineExecutions
                    - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                    - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
                  Resource: '*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Permissions Boundary (applied only when auto-monitoring is enabled)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotPermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: IsAutoMonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'marbot-boundary-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Permissions boundary restricting marbot cross-account role to monitoring-related actions only'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:ListRules
              - events:ListTargetsByRule
              - events:PutRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:RemoveTargets
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:EnableRule
              - events:DisableRule
              - sns:ListTopics
              - sns:Subscribe
              - sns:Unsubscribe
              - sns:GetTopicAttributes
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - codepipeline:ListPipelineExecutions
              - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
              - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
            Resource: '*'

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function for the custom resource (registers with marbot)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotRegistrationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-cr-lambda-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/marbot-cr-${AWS::StackName}:*'

  MarbotRegistrationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'marbot-cr-${AWS::StackName}'
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib3
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          http = urllib3.PoolManager()

          MARBOT_API_URL = 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/accounts/connect'

          SUCCESS = 'SUCCESS'
          FAILED = 'FAILED'

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id):
              response_body = {
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': 'See the details in CloudWatch Log Stream: ' + context.log_stream_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_body = json.dumps(response_body)
              logger.info('Sending CFN response: %s', json_body)
              url = event.get('ResponseURL', '')
              if url:
                  try:
                      resp = http.request('PUT', url, body=json_body, headers={'Content-Type': ''})
                      logger.info('CFN response status: %s', resp.status)
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.error('Failed to send CFN response: %s', str(e))
                      raise

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event: %s', json.dumps(event))

              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'marbot-registration-' + props.get('StackId', 'unknown'))

              endpoint_id = props.get('EndpointId', '')
              role_arn = props.get('RoleArn', '')
              external_id = props.get('ExternalId', '')
              account_id = props.get('AccountId', '')
              stack_id = props.get('StackId', '')

              headers = {
                  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                  'Authorization': 'marbot-' + endpoint_id,
                  'x-api-key': endpoint_id
              }

              try:
                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      payload = {
                          'action': 'register',
                          'accountId': account_id,
                          'roleArn': role_arn,
                          'externalId': external_id,
                          'stackId': stack_id,
                          'endpointId': endpoint_id,
                          'region': os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', '')
                      }
                      try:
                          resp = http.request(
                              'POST',
                              MARBOT_API_URL,
                              body=json.dumps(payload),
                              headers=headers,
                              timeout=urllib3.Timeout(connect=10, read=15)
                          )
                          logger.info('Registration response status=%s body=%s', resp.status, resp.data)
                          if resp.status >= 400:
                              logger.warning('Marbot registration returned error (non-fatal): %s %s', resp.status, resp.data)
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning('Marbot registration API call failed (non-fatal): %s', str(e))

                      send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {
                          'RegistrationStatus': 'registered',
                      }, physical_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      payload = {
                          'action': 'disconnect',
                          'accountId': account_id,
                          'stackId': stack_id,
                          'endpointId': endpoint_id
                      }
                      try:
                          resp = http.request(
                              'POST',
                              MARBOT_API_URL,
                              body=json.dumps(payload),
                              headers=headers,
                              timeout=urllib3.Timeout(connect=10, read=15)
                          )
                          logger.info('Disconnect response status=%s body=%s', resp.status, resp.data)
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning('Disconnect call failed (non-fatal): %s', str(e))

                      send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {
                          'RegistrationStatus': 'disconnected'
                      }, physical_id)

                  else:
                      send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)

              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error('Error processing event: %s', str(e))
                  send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {
                      'Error': str(e)
                  }, physical_id)

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom Resource – registers the account connection with marbot
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotRegistration:
    Type: Custom::MarbotRegistration
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunction.Arn
      EndpointId: !Ref MarbotEndpointId
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
      ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      StackId: !Ref AWS::StackId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained backend for a mobile/web application: a provisioned
  DynamoDB table with a numeric id partition key and a global secondary
  index on id, a Cognito identity pool permitting unauthenticated guest
  access, the unauthenticated IAM role, and the identity pool role
  attachment that grants guests analytics, Cognito Sync, SNS publish, and
  DynamoDB write access.

Resources:
  GuestAppTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: GuestAppData
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: ByIdIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10

  GuestIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: GuestAppIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  GuestUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: GuestAppUnauthenticatedRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref GuestIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GuestAppUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowMobileAnalyticsEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: AllowCognitoSync
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${GuestIdentityPool}/*"
              - Sid: AllowSnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
              - Sid: AllowDynamoDbWrites
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt GuestAppTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${GuestAppTable.Arn}/index/*"

  GuestIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref GuestIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt GuestUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Catalog and Transform Layer for Data Lake - Glue Database, Crawler, and Spark ETL Job'

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Naming prefix for all resources (alphanumeric and underscores only)
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    Default: datalake

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  SourceBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the existing source S3 bucket that the crawler scans
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    Default: my-source-bucket

  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix/path within the source bucket for crawler to scan (do not start with /)
    Default: ''

  CrawlerEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable or disable the Glue Crawler (true/false)
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Cron schedule expression for the crawler (default once daily at midnight UTC). Use 6-field format with ? for day-of-week.'
    Default: '0 0 * * ? *'

  ETLEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable or disable the Glue Spark ETL job (true/false)
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  ETLWorkerType:
    Type: String
    Description: Worker type for the Glue Spark ETL job (e.g., Standard)
    Default: Standard

  ETLWorkerCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of workers for the Glue Spark ETL job
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 299

  ETLTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: Execution timeout in minutes for the Glue Spark job
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1440

  ETLMaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum concurrent runs for the Glue Spark job
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100

  ETLScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 URL of the ETL script (e.g., s3://bucket/scripts/etl.py)
    Default: s3://my-etl-scripts/etl.py

  TargetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the target S3 bucket for transformed output (leave empty if not needed)
    Default: ''

  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix/path within the target bucket for output (do not start with /)
    Default: ''

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period for CloudWatch logs in days
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653

Conditions:
  IsCrawlerEnabled: !Equals [!Ref CrawlerEnabled, 'true']
  IsETLEnabled: !Equals [!Ref ETLEnabled, 'true']
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketName, '']]

Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Join ['_', [!Ref NamePrefix, !Ref Environment, 'database']]
        Description: !Join [' ', ['Data lake catalog database for', !Ref Environment]]

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join ['_', [!Ref NamePrefix, !Ref Environment, 'glue_service_role']]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Join ['_', [!Ref NamePrefix, !Ref Environment, 'source_bucket_read']]
      Roles:
        - !Ref GlueServiceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Join ['', ['arn:aws:s3:::', !Ref SourceBucketName]]
              - !Join ['', ['arn:aws:s3:::', !Ref SourceBucketName, '/*']]

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasTargetBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Join ['_', [!Ref NamePrefix, !Ref Environment, 'target_bucket_write']]
      Roles:
        - !Ref GlueServiceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource:
              - !Join ['', ['arn:aws:s3:::', !Ref TargetBucketName]]
              - !Join ['', ['arn:aws:s3:::', !Ref TargetBucketName, '/*']]

  JobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: IsETLEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Join ['/', ['/aws/glue/jobs', !Ref NamePrefix, !Ref Environment]]
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: IsCrawlerEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['_', [!Ref NamePrefix, !Ref Environment, 'crawler']]
      Description: !Join [' ', ['Data lake crawler for', !Ref Environment]]
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase

Description: >-

  routing controls, safety assertion rule, and Route 53 recovery control health

Parameters:
  Region1:
    Type: String
    Description: First AWS Region used in the Cell1 routing control name.
    Default: us-east-1
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region code such as us-east-1.
  Region2:
    Type: String
    Description: Second AWS Region used in the Cell2 routing control name.
    Default: us-west-2
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region code such as us-west-2.
  ProjectId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Project identifier used as a prefix for all resource names. Must be an
      alphanumeric string starting with a letter, 1 to 64 characters long.
    Default: Dynamo59
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an alphanumeric string that starts with a letter and is between
      1 and 64 characters long.

Resources:
  Cluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectId}-Cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectId}-Cluster"
        - Key: ProjectId
          Value: !Ref ProjectId

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectId}-ControlPanel"

      ClusterArn: !GetAtt Cluster.ClusterArn

  Cell2RoutingControl:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:

        - Key: ProjectId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a customer-managed AWS KMS key with rotation enabled and retention
  policies applied, along with a retained alias, to secure AWS service data
  encryption. Optionally creates an EventBridge rule that alerts via an SNS
  topic owned by a parent alerting stack when the key is scheduled for deletion
  or disabled.

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Name of the parent CloudFormation stack that exports the SNS topic ARN
      (export name '<ParentAlertStack>-SnsTopicArn') used for deletion alerts.
      Leave empty to skip deletion alerting.
    Default: ''
  Service:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      AWS service whose data encryption is secured by this KMS key. Use
      'ALL_SERVICES' for unrestricted account crypto access or
      'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS' to permit public decryption of KMS-encrypted S3
      objects. A concrete service restricts crypto access to requests made
      via that service through a kms:ViaService condition.
    Default: ALL_SERVICES
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL_SERVICES
      - S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces

Conditions:
  IsAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, ALL_SERVICES]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS]
  IsAlertsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub
        - 'Customer-managed KMS key for ${Service} (stack ${StackName})'
        - Service: !Ref Service
          StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM user permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - IsS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: Enable public S3 decryption
              Effect: Allow
              Principal: '*'
              Action:
                - kms:Decrypt
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !If
              - IsAllServices
              - Sid: Enable crypto operations for the account
                Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                Action:
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Enable crypto operations via the selected service
                Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                Action:
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService:
                      Fn::Sub: '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: iac-god-eval

  KeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  KmsKeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: IsAlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub
        - 'Detects ScheduleKeyDeletion/DisableKey for KMS key ${StackName}'
        - StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.kms
        detail-type:
          - 'AWS API Call via CloudTrail'
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - kms.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - ScheduleKeyDeletion
            - DisableKey
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref KmsKey
              - !Ref KeyAlias
              - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Targets:
        - Id: KMSKeyDeletionAlert
          Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue:
              Fn::Sub: '${ParentAlertStack}-SnsTopicArn'

Outputs:
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: The unique identifier of the created KMS key
    Value: !Ref KmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the created KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'

  role, used to automate EBS volume snapshot management for web servers.

  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:

        Parameters:
          - DailySnapshotScheduledAt

        Parameters:

        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - TagKey
          - TagValue
    ParameterLabels:
      DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
        default: Daily snapshot time (HH:MM UTC)
      SnapshotInterval:
        default: Snapshot interval (hours)
      SnapshotRetainRule:
        default: Snapshots to retain
      LogicalName:
        default: Logical name
      Environment:
        default: Environment tag value
      TagKey:
        default: Custom tag key
      TagValue:
        default: Custom tag value

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: "17:00"
    AllowedPattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a time in HH:MM (24-hour, UTC) format.
    Description: >-
      Daily time, in UTC and HH:MM format, at which the snapshots are created.

  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24
    Description: Interval, in hours, between snapshots.

  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of snapshots to retain.

  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    MaxLength: 28
    Description: >-
      Logical name used as a prefix for the IAM role name and the DLM policy
      Name tag. Keep it short so the derived IAM role name stays within the
      64-character limit.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    Description: Environment tag value used to select the target EBS volumes.

  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9 +\-=._:/@]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid EC2 tag key.
    Description: Additional tag key used to select the target EBS volumes.

  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    Description: Additional tag value used to select the target EBS volumes.

  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: >-

        EBS volume snapshots for web servers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDlmServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Statement:

                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:snapshot/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
              - Sid: SnapshotTagManagement

                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:snapshot/*'

  DataLifecycleManagerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Daily EBS volume snapshots for ${Environment} web servers'
      State: ENABLED

      PolicyDetails:

        ResourceTypes:

        TargetTags:

            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CopyTags: true
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager.
    Value: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn

  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager.
    Value: !Ref DataLifecycleManagerRole

  LifecyclePolicyId:
    Description: ID of the DLM EBS volume lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Ref DataLifecycleManagerPolicy

  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Description: Name tag of the DLM EBS volume lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true

        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  # Resource Server with custom scopes (must exist before client references them)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

        - ScopeName: write

        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

          secretsmanager = boto3.client("secretsmanager")

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event["RequestType"]
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              user_pool_id = props["UserPoolId"]
              client_id = props["ClientId"]
              secret_name = props["SecretName"]
              project_name = props["ProjectName"]

              try:
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      # Describe the client to get the client secret
                      response = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          ClientId=client_id
                      )
                      client_secret = response["UserPoolClient"].get("ClientSecret")
                      if not client_secret:
                          raise Exception("ClientSecret not found in describe_user_pool_client response")

                      secret_value = json.dumps({
                          "client_id": client_id,
                          "client_secret": client_secret,
                          "user_pool_id": user_pool_id
                      })

                      if request_type == "Create":
                          secretsmanager.create_secret(
                              Name=secret_name,
                              SecretString=secret_value,
                              Tags=[
                                  {"Key": "ManagedBy", "Value": "iac-god-eval"}
                              ]
                          )
                          logger.info("Created secret %s", secret_name)
                      else:
                          try:
                              secretsmanager.update_secret(
                                  SecretId=secret_name,
                                  SecretString=secret_value
                              )
                              logger.info("Updated secret %s", secret_name)
                          except secretsmanager.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                              secretsmanager.create_secret(
                                  Name=secret_name,
                                  SecretString=secret_value,
                                  Tags=[
                                      {"Key": "ManagedBy", "Value": "iac-god-eval"}
                                  ]
                              )
                              logger.info("Created (recovered) secret %s", secret_name)

                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})

                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      try:
                          secretsmanager.delete_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True
                          )
                          logger.info("Force-deleted secret %s", secret_name)
                      except secretsmanager.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          logger.info("Secret %s already deleted, skipping", secret_name)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})

              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error("Error: %s", str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"error": str(e)})

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito identity bootstrap for multi-tenant SaaS operations application'

Parameters:
  TenantAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Tenant application callback host (e.g., https://tenant.example.com)
  AdminAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Admin application callback host (e.g., https://admin.example.com)
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    Description: Name for the siloed tenant IAM role

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # POOLED TENANT USER POOL
  # ============================================================
  PooledTenantUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
          AttributeDataType: String
        - Name: tenantId
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          AttributeDataType: String
        - Name: userRole
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          AttributeDataType: String
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'Verify your email'
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: !Sub 'Your username is {username} and temporary password is {####}. Please click here: ${TenantAppCallbackHost}'
          EmailSubject: 'Welcome to the SaaS Operations Platform'
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  PooledTenantUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref TenantAppCallbackHost
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref TenantAppCallbackHost
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours
      IdTokenValidity: 12

  PooledTenantUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}'

  # ============================================================
  # POOLED TENANT IDENTITY POOL
  # ============================================================
  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt PooledTenantUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  PooledTenantIdentityPoolPrincipalTag:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}'
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  # DynamoDB tables
  PooledProductTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: PooledTenant-Product
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: SK
          KeyType: RANGE

  PooledOrderTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: PooledTenant-Order
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: SK
          KeyType: RANGE

  TenantUserMappingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: TenantUserMapping
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH

  TenantDetailsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: TenantDetails
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH

  TenantStackMappingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: TenantStackMapping
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH

  SettingsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Settings
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH

  # Pooled tenant authenticated IAM role
  PooledTenantAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Tenant-prefixed item access on pooled Product and Order tables
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLSelect
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLInsert
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLUpdate
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLDelete
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PooledProductTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${PooledProductTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt PooledOrderTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${PooledOrderTable.Arn}/index/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  ForAllValues:StringLike:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}-*'
              # TenantAdmin access to TenantUserMapping, TenantDetails, TenantStackMapping, Settings
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLSelect
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLInsert
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLUpdate
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLDelete
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TenantUserMappingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TenantUserMappingTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TenantDetailsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TenantDetailsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TenantStackMappingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TenantStackMappingTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt SettingsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SettingsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              # SystemAdmin access to all tables and indexes
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLSelect
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLInsert
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLUpdate
                  - dynamodb:PartiQLDelete
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PooledProductTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${PooledProductTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt PooledOrderTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${PooledOrderTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TenantUserMappingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TenantUserMappingTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TenantDetailsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TenantDetailsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TenantStackMappingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TenantStackMappingTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt SettingsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SettingsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:

                Condition:

    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Reusable DynamoDB table stack with configurable attributes, indexes, scaling, backup, and alarms'

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the partition key (hash key)
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid DynamoDB attribute name

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of the partition key
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    ConstraintDescription: Must be S (String), N (Number), or B (Binary)

  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional name for the DynamoDB table. If empty, a name will be generated.
    Default: ''

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the sort key (range key). Leave empty for no sort key.
    Default: ''

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of the sort key
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    ConstraintDescription: Must be S (String), N (Number), or B (Binary)

  ExtraAttribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of an extra attribute definition (1 of 3). Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''

  ExtraAttribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of extra attribute 1
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  ExtraAttribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of an extra attribute definition (2 of 3). Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''

  ExtraAttribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of extra attribute 2
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  ExtraAttribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of an extra attribute definition (3 of 3). Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''

  ExtraAttribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of extra attribute 3
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the first global secondary index. Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''

  GSI1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key name for GSI 1
    Default: ''

  GSI1PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key type for GSI 1
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  GSI1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Sort key name for GSI 1. Leave empty for no sort key.
    Default: ''

  GSI1SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Sort key type for GSI 1
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the second global secondary index. Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''

  GSI2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key name for GSI 2
    Default: ''

  GSI2PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key type for GSI 2
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  GSI2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Sort key name for GSI 2. Leave empty for no sort key.
    Default: ''

  GSI2SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Sort key type for GSI 2
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  TimeToLiveAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Time to Live attribute. Leave empty to disable TTL.
    Default: ''

  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Description: When enabled, specifies the type of information written to the stream
    Default: ''
    AllowedValues:
      - ''
      - KEYS_ONLY
      - NEW_IMAGE
      - OLD_IMAGE
      - NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Billing mode for the table
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (only used when BillingMode is PROVISIONED)
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (only used when BillingMode is PROVISIONED)
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000

  ReadScalingMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum read capacity for auto scaling
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  ReadScalingMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum read capacity for auto scaling
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  WriteScalingMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum write capacity for auto scaling
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  WriteScalingMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum write capacity for auto scaling
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Description: Target utilization percentage for auto scaling
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100

  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery for the table
    Default: true
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false

  SSESpecificationEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with AWS managed KMS key
    Default: false
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false

  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain backups. Set to 0 to disable AWS Backup entirely.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 365

  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alarm notifications. Leave empty to skip alarm creation.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]

  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]

  HasExtraAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute1Name, '']]
  HasExtraAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute2Name, '']]
  HasExtraAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute3Name, '']]

  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1Name, '']]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2Name, '']]

  HasGSI1SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI2SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, '']]

  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttributeName, '']]

  HasStream: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, '']]

  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  IsOnDemand: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PAY_PER_REQUEST]

  PITREnabled: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, true]

  SSEEnabled: !Equals [!Ref SSESpecificationEnabled, true]

  BackupEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]

  AlarmsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]

  AlarmsAndBackup: !And
    - !Condition AlarmsEnabled
    - !Condition BackupEnabled

Resources:
  # IAM Role for DynamoDB Auto Scaling
  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - application-autoscaling:*
                Resource: '*'

  # DynamoDB Table
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      BillingMode: !If [IsOnDemand, PAY_PER_REQUEST, PROVISIONED]
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsOnDemand
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - PITREnabled
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      SSESpecification: !If
        - SSEEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStream
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes: !If
        - HasGSI1
        - - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsOnDemand
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
          - !If
            - HasGSI2
            - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasGSI2SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsOnDemand
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # Auto Scaling for Read Capacity
  ReadScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadScalingMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadScalingMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${DynamoDBTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadScalingPolicy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalingTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  # Auto Scaling for Write Capacity
  WriteScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteScalingMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteScalingMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${DynamoDBTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WriteScalingPolicy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalingTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # AWS Backup Resources
  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: BackupEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-backup-vault'

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: BackupEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-rule'
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: BackupEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                  - backup:CreateBackupSelection
                  - backup:CreateBackupPlan
                  - backup:ListBackupPlans
                  - backup:ListBackupVaults
                Resource: '*'

  BackupPlanSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: BackupEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${DynamoDBTable}'

  # CloudWatch Alarms
  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alert when read throttle events exceed threshold for ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alert when write throttle events exceed threshold for ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alert when throttled requests exceed threshold for ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alert when user errors exceed threshold for ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alert when system errors exceed threshold for ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  BackupVaultNotificationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsAndBackup
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BackupVaultNotifications'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alert on backup vault events for ${BackupVault}'
      Namespace: AWS/Backup
      MetricName: NumberOfBackupJobsCompleted
      Dimensions:
        - Name: BackupVaultName
          Value: !Ref BackupVault
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableName'

  StreamArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB stream (if enabled)
    Condition: HasStream
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StreamArn'

      - Key: Name

        Value: StreamlitApp-NATGW2-EIP

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Service Catalog preventive controls test environment

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for subnet 1
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for subnet 2

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-vpc

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-subnet-1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-subnet-2

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog test resources
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-sg

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  TestKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for Service Catalog test resources
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Grant use of the key to Service Catalog launch roles
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoScalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DMSEndpointInstanceLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EBSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EFSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FSxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SNSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SQSServiceCatalogLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-kms-key

  TestKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sc-test-kms-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TestKMSKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS Replication Subnet Group + Service Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  DMSVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dms-vpc-role

  DMSReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: Replication subnet group for Service Catalog DMS tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-dms-replication-subnet-group

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # ElastiCache Subnet Group + Cache Security Group
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group for Service Catalog ElastiCache tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-elasticache-subnet-group

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Cache security group for Service Catalog ElastiCache tests

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Execution Role

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-sagemaker-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
